stav-p00-v01.quick_english: By sweet speech mind-captivating, by seeing, by being seen — conquers whose greatness is manifest bliss — supreme lord.

stav-p01-v02.quick_english: Who, grown great with glory-compassion-awakening-bliss wealth, knowledge-lit in greatness — he conquers, the undefeated.

stav-p01-v03.quick_english: To the forth-flowing drop-and-resonance, to the pure-nectar self: bow; to endless light, to Śaṃkara the milk-ocean.

stav-p01-v04.quick_english: We hate you, we praise you, to you we address — O Ambikā’s husband; by great accessibility, well done: you have held the all for us.

stav-p01-v05.quick_english: To withdrawn-touch-yoked, full-nectar-streamed, sky-and-mAyA-formed, to the vast — to Śambhu: bow.

stav-p01-v06.quick_english: Among the split, not split — what is uncut among the cut: we bow to that all-common form of the supreme Lord.

stav-p01-v07.quick_english: Finer than praNava’s upper half-mora even — to the minute, to the great again; greater than the world-egg even — to the qualityless-qualified, to SthANu: bow.

stav-p01-v08.quick_english: Her who wombs the world-egg — of sky-pervading, all-going supreme-Lord goose — power: goose-like, we praise.

stav-p01-v09.quick_english: Provision without material, on no wall at all, they extend — the world-picture: bow to him, art-praised trident-bearer.

stav-p01-v10.quick_english: From mAyA-water’s belly fully drawn out, made stainless — Śiva-knowledge, self-milked: give, come, O Hara-goose, to us.

stav-p01-v11.quick_english: Even in difference-yoga from six-valid-means-delimitation — to the undivided, to ultimate-truth-one-being: offering we go, to Bhava, to you.

stav-p02-v12.quick_english: May we see the deep — supreme, light-circled, darkness-wiped, lovely: dwell within your cave.

stav-p02-v13.quick_english: Homage even to those who see in dream the lord, moon-crescent-crowned, giver of supreme bliss.

stav-p02-v14.quick_english: O Blessed, be — the desire to contemplate your being — skilled at cutting rebirth-fear: to whom is it not pleasing?

stav-p02-v15.quick_english: O lord of worlds, let this be our lifelong duty: by your grace, by single-pointed staying.

stav-p02-v16.quick_english: Bow to Śambhu: self made of thousand-spread Veda-āgama, wish-fulfilling endless-fruit tree.

stav-p02-v17.quick_english: Having entrusted speech-mind-body actions in you, O Lord, becoming you-made — may we be pair-free, even sometime.

stav-p02-v18.quick_english: Bow to the trident-bearer, possessing power independent of others, in worlds' creation-dissolution appointments.

stav-p02-v19.quick_english: What fruit from other supports for those who meditate — even the name of Dhūrjaṭi, chief meditation-object past guṇa-yoga?

stav-p02-v20.quick_english: Homage, homage, to Śiva — by mantra-power taking refuge: praiseworthy those who strive to enjoy your Śāmbhavī bhūti.

stav-p02-v21.quick_english: What path by which you are not attained, what speech by which you are not said, what meditation by which you are not meditated — or what are you not, O Lord?

stav-p03-v22.quick_english: Such indeed this — worshipped, meditated, pleased: may this rasa grow in you, Bhava, by thousand streams.

stav-p03-v23.quick_english: Bow: to the Lord, to Sthāṇu, to you — serpent-thread-wearing, whose self is the abode of the intellect-lords' garland.

stav-p03-v24.quick_english: Your remembrance is the one medicine for ignorance-darkness; Bhava, by its giving — let grace be done in me.

stav-p03-v25.quick_english: Bow to Īśa, fulfiller of all human ends: even the homage of the wise here is to be offered — whose.

stav-p03-v26.quick_english: Immersed in the terrible bhava-ocean, abode of suffering-fish, having obtained Śarva's devotion-jewel: what is not conquered?

stav-p03-v27.quick_english: You indeed are to-be-known, O Dhūrjaṭi — of unobstructed, pairless, steady knowledge-wealth — by such as these who know you.

stav-p03-v28.quick_english: One quality-less to-be-known even, the unborn conquers — desire-less by nature, the supreme fruit of desires.

stav-p03-v29.quick_english: That milk-ocean lordship — your own, natural, O Lord — where not labored by some gods for Śrī-ratna-nectar gain.

stav-p03-v30.quick_english: Bow — by devotion, for liberation of men he blossoms: O Bhava, to you, O Protector — by remembrance and by praise they give to Śambhu: bliss in bhava, in abhava.

stav-p03-v31.quick_english: All-knowing, all-doing, all is you — thus for knowers of knowledge: what knowable or karma, O Lord, for endlessness, is offered?

stav-p04-v32.quick_english: Of whose mere will this three-world-whole is the fruit — who knows, O lord, how far your works reach?

stav-p04-v33.quick_english: Even Brahmā and others hasten higher and higher by his work-stair-series to win the abode — to him I bow.

stav-p04-v34.quick_english: 'This is Brahmā, this Great Indra, these sun and moon' — thus blossomed as his power-creeper: may that Bhava protect.

stav-p04-v35.quick_english: No delusion is found of him even by deluded hearts; even by far-goers his end — impassable setting — we praise Mṛḍa.

stav-p04-v36.quick_english: Bow in praise, in remembrance, in meditation, in seeing, in touch, likewise in attainment — and to bliss-mass, to beloved, to matted-haired.

stav-p04-v37.quick_english: 'What with pride?' having even thought with mind, O Supreme Lord — 'with pride I am made-of-you' — me (?) not in self, what with joy?

stav-p04-v38.quick_english: Having weighed even duty-crores, from mind's fickleness — resting, O Bhava, in your mind-bliss I delight greatly.

stav-p04-v39.quick_english: If even subtle, how is this three-world a mere part of you? If gross, then why not easily seen even by Brahmā and others, O lord?

stav-p04-v40.quick_english: If this 'you indeed are their expressible' had not been — what wise one, O god, would then have taken trouble in word-nets?

stav-p04-v41.quick_english: By which course, by which rite, or by which wisdom, O lord, are you visible — by teaching show grace to me.

stav-p05-v42.quick_english: Bow to needing-no-service, sole helper of three worlds; to of-all-desired, to desireless, to matted-haired.

stav-p05-v43.quick_english: Ah, this very discernment of the good for the great purpose — whereby these sow in you endless-fruited devotion, O lord.

stav-p05-v44.quick_english: Ah, great is this māyā of yours, O wielder, veiled by which — even on gaining the treasure of meditation on you — the bewildered people slacken.

stav-p05-v45.quick_english: In every undertaking, O Bhava — act or means-and-rest or all, let be — but the free doer therein alone is you.

stav-p05-v46.quick_english: The three worlds seized by three-guṇa triple-throb dualities — to rescue, other than you, whose is the power, or the grace?

stav-p05-v47.quick_english: What fault is fault, even O god, in one set on reaching you? What virtue is virtue, pray, in one set on not reaching you? Let passion be, O world-lord — mine which rests in you alone; and bow even to greed, my own whose prop is gaining you.

stav-p05-v48.quick_english: Ah, great is this deed, O god, consisting of contemplation on you — in which from Brahmā to worm, who of us is not made eligible for liberation?

stav-p05-v49.quick_english: Beginning of all works, end of all rites, the various inner happenings between — yours indeed, O lord, on thought's path.

stav-p05-v50.quick_english: While higher thousandfold expanse of taste — than your devotion-rasa-nectars, O lord, not elsewhere is seen.

stav-p06-v51.quick_english: Bow to master Soma — desire withdrawn, longing stretched, moon-crested.

stav-p06-v52.quick_english: 'What can I, incapable, do?' — for one who resolves nothing anywhere: Śaṅkara's all-befriending power is my refuge.

stav-p06-v53.quick_english: Of you beyond guṇas, whose self is described as utter excellence — in which part, O Bhava, is a substitute for you found?

stav-p06-v54.quick_english: Though you, the self, are nondual and limitless, O lord — even now we are cheated by your unmeasured māyā.

stav-p06-v55.quick_english: Attainment of powers from aṇimā onward, eternal lordship, end of becoming — these, O Bhava, are sprouts of the wish-tree of devotion to you.

stav-p06-v56.quick_english: Whatever quarter, there you are never absent; all time is made of you — thus already won, yet when will you be won, O lord? Tell.

stav-p06-v57.quick_english: Bow to Śambhu — sole dweller in clear good hearts, white-limbed with much ash, great swan.

stav-p06-v58.quick_english: Dispersing surging darkness, having burned all becoming-fuel — may your awareness-lamp be mine, O lord — your devotion-lamp.

stav-p06-v59.quick_english: Having staged the three-world-play pregnant with many true emitted seeds — O Hara, to dissolve it, who but you is a capable poet?

stav-p06-v60.quick_english: Bow to make real-and-unreal into non-being or being indeed — to free and unfree, to embodying-expenditure-and-dominion.

stav-p07-v61.quick_english: Whatever bliss at all is seen here even in three worlds — that is a drop of whom: to that god, bliss-ocean, I bow.

stav-p07-v62.quick_english: Ah, blessed are Brahmā and others who, having dropped all other talk, mutter overwhelmed with joy 'homage, homage to Śiva'.

stav-p07-v63.quick_english: To desireless yet ordainer of endless desires; even in world's beginninglessness, to enjoyer — O Bhava, let bow be to you.

stav-p07-v64.quick_english: We praise the lord, root-nature of three-world-beginning — who would seek any service from him, since of perfect nature?

stav-p07-v65.quick_english: Even in great hard straits, dirtied by delusion-flood — when he is remembered, minds clear: that Śiva we praise.

stav-p07-v66.quick_english: O lord, from you alone here sovereign power unbroken — by whose will the three worlds' dissolution and rise unfold.

stav-p07-v67.quick_english: Even evil deed aimed at which god would become supreme good; even good deed's goodness — since elsewhere you are not so, O!

stav-p07-v68.quick_english: 'Seized by fist you are, seen you are — where go you from us?' — thus, puffed with devotion-rasa, the blessed run to Dhūrjaṭi.

stav-p07-v69.quick_english: We praise you — of Ṛk-Yajus-Sāman, from bright, from beyond, beyond — whose Veda-embodied knowable — ah, deep-lovely.

stav-p07-v70.quick_english: Rule, beginning, so end you are of the world, O Supreme Lord — the dharma-multitude set forth: which is not from you — from where would it be?

stav-p08-v71.quick_english: Bow to you who, having manifested the becoming-agitated delusion, breaks it — to knowledge-bliss, nondual — O god, having covered, to uncoverer.

stav-p08-v72.quick_english: By which wishes could her end-distinction be reached — stealing māyā in one wink — may that Śiva protect us.

stav-p08-v73.quick_english: Weighty course of dispassion, supreme glory of knowledge, highest peak of desirelessness — of bearing these, you, O lord, are lord.

stav-p08-v74.quick_english: Even of Brahmā you are Brahmā; of whom, O lord of lords, are you not lord — world-welfare's welfare, how great you are — who knows?

stav-p08-v75.quick_english: What with other kin, what with friends and masters likewise — in every place, my lord, you are who lifts from the becoming-ocean.

stav-p08-v76.quick_english: Victorious are drops of divine nectar — drawn by Śaiva-yoga power, able to wash the stain of delusion-māyā and the rest.

stav-p08-v77.quick_english: By Gāyatrī is sung whose thought-radiance impelling — may he impel, I hope, our thoughts on the true path, the lord.

stav-p08-v78.quick_english: O eight-formed, in even one form will you not make eternal standing for us — or pleased, will you do all?

stav-p08-v79.quick_english: Reality-principle of categories generally effects purpose — but yours, O lord, even the name gives accomplishment up to liberation.

stav-p08-v80.quick_english: Again and again, to arrange each next state of the world-picture — by that power of yours, O lord, what mindful one is not amazed?

stav-p09-v81.quick_english: To make hard easy, to gladden suffering likewise — sole-heroic is whose remembrance: him we remember, love's foe.

stav-p09-v82.quick_english: Victorious are songs whose singable is the supreme lord — by whose name even great souls are sown with thrill-sprouts.

stav-p09-v83.quick_english: As you, indeed you would be, if supreme — O Bhava, whose three-world-beginning-dissolution is arrayed by own power formations.

stav-p09-v84.quick_english: Mantra you are, counsel-worthy you are, counsellor — whence another than you? He — to me give that mantra, so that I may be your mantra, O lord.

stav-p09-v85.quick_english: Light-formed, true-resolve, you are the self of whom — even he am I — 'transmigrator' thus — what, O lord, is this — that dream even, whence in you?

stav-p09-v86.quick_english: That unbroken, that unvulgar, that one, coherent — in you, O lord, is the lordship of those who entrust work-fruits.

stav-p09-v87.quick_english: Capable — what misfortune not to destroy, what fortune not to give, or — who is that-one: he is our beloved, god of gods, bull-bannered.

stav-p09-v88.quick_english: For the divine knowledge-eye blinded by māyā-made stain — in purifying, O lord, devotion to you is the supreme ointment.

stav-p09-v89.quick_english: Fearless, bliss-constituted, one, imperishable — give the state, come to me, O god — quickly — why wait for that?

stav-p09-v90.quick_english: Ah, naturally deep, dreadful is the transmigration-ocean; ah, the means to cross it — the supreme someone — great lord.

stav-p10-v91.quick_english: Bow to you, ender of death, crusher of love, Gaṅgā on head, doer of what is right as fitting.

stav-p10-v92.quick_english: Above even lordship, knowledge, dispassion, dharmas — the standing prayed for: without you, O lord, what higher resort for those praying?

stav-p10-v93.quick_english: When you do not will, who is capable, O Śambhu, to bend grass? But favoured by your will — who would not carry Brahmā's yoke?

stav-p10-v94.quick_english: Heads raised with jewel-crowns of bowing to Hara — the wisdom-rich: to what supreme would they bow, or whom would they not bend?

stav-p10-v95.quick_english: Tremorless, shed of all wandering, nectar-lake — the middle of your knowledge-ocean — may I dwell upon, O Dhūrjaṭi.

stav-p10-v96.quick_english: Wonder that — even strangely seen, even gone into wish — ultimate fruit, O lord, full you grant.

stav-p10-v97.quick_english: Who is greater than you by virtues? Who attributeless greater than you? Thus, O lord, we laud — do we praise you? Do we blame? We do not think.

stav-p10-v98.quick_english: Even in praising, of the nectar-flood — of which favour is your fruit — that to drink, who else is capable — how much more to give, O world-lord?

stav-p10-v99.quick_english: From treasury of accomplishment of hosts of wholly desirable things — from you, devotion to you alone to obtain I pray, O lord, in every way.

stav-p10-v100.quick_english: Bow to three-world-lord, to you, O Bhava — of those attending you — to unimpeded power giving three-world-lordship.

stav-p11-v101.quick_english: Of abandoning all suffering the cause who — when in such doubt — O master, 'he you are' having decided — who has not gone to you as refuge?

stav-p11-v102.quick_english: Having enjoyed enjoyments, having dropped becoming-delusion, I will attain the supreme state — thus the hope here: may it shine supremely of the devout in Śambhu.

stav-p11-v103.quick_english: O lord, even in dream whatever I may do or say, good or bad — with pride of dependence on you — everywhere here I am content.

stav-p11-v104.quick_english: Of lights even which light — there in your abode of the running mind — O lord of mind, touch of darkness — I think, barren-woman's-son's-younger-brother.

stav-p11-v105.quick_english: I think, foot placed even on the benign path of liberation — stands whose wish: 'I will serve Śiva' — this.

stav-p11-v106.quick_english: By maintenance, origin, dissolutions, in services of three worlds here — alone indeed, O lord, your power — free — the loom you oversee.

stav-p11-v107.quick_english: In three worlds here who is saved, by triple suffering not afflicted — to him let bow be, to you — who you are that extinction-nectar-lake.

stav-p11-v108.quick_english: Even artificial devotion to you has genuine fruit arising — if this were guileless, what-fruited — by you let it be said.

stav-p11-v109.quick_english: That eye by which you are seen, that way by which you are reached — that fruit, O unborn, is born — which is from the wish-tree of talk about you.

stav-p11-v110.quick_english: Better than good indeed is this — above, in you, which standing — for removing obstacles to that, you, O lord, are my refuge.

stav-p12-v111.quick_english: Ah, sweetest is the nectar-taste of hoping to serve Śarva — where in a mere digit of time does it not become ever-fresh?

stav-p12-v112.quick_english: Again and again untiring, three worlds with hundreds of imaginings imagining even — who yet one, undifferentiated, conquers — unborn.

stav-p12-v113.quick_english: By the knowledge-lamp burning the wick of transmigration-latencies anointed with stain-oil — O god, when to you may I be present, pray?

stav-p12-v114.quick_english: Even one wink, if fault-waned you make foot in mind — then, O Śambhu, what will you not accomplish?

stav-p12-v115.quick_english: 'Blessed I am, duty done I am, great I am' — thus conviction would be with-support — his who has you as support, O lord.

stav-p12-v116.quick_english: Of all auspicious and inauspicious yourself the doer you are — but devotion to you is mother of auspicious alone, O lord, only.

stav-p12-v117.quick_english: When mind is clear, O master — do you enter, or from your entering does it clear — thus the person swings.

stav-p12-v118.quick_english: But this certainty here — supervision by you alone indeed — grace of mind, O master — that is accomplishment, that supreme state.

stav-p12-v119.quick_english: Speech and mind and deed and my body — which, O lord — by your grace may that be ornamented alone with devotion to you.

stav-p12-v120.quick_english: The wish-jewel of praise, giving rich fruits of wishes, abode of devotion's fortune — O Śambhu — Bhaṭṭanārāyaṇa made.

stav-p04-v36.inference: Bow everywhere to the beloved bliss-mass, matted-haired.

stav-p04-v37.speaker: Devotee (questioning pride)
stav-p04-v37.question: What with pride, what with joy?
premises: 'What with pride?' having even thought with mind, O Supreme Lord.
'With pride I am made-of-you' — me(?) not in self — what with joy?
stav-p04-v37.inference: Thinking pride, claiming made-of-you, yet not in self — what joy?
uncertainties: Vṛtti M00089 primary: māmi = paripūrṇatayā sphurāmi (I shine forth); yadvā na māmi = na varte (I abide not). Smayena pride vs smile; mudā with-joy kept.

option_choices.reason: Pride (arrogance at made-of-you claim) vs smile; T1 pride kept, smile needs Vṛtti.
Vṛtti primary paripūrṇatayā sphurāmi (I shine forth); na-varte alternative recorded.
With-joy (instrumental accompaniment); for-joy purpose is same rite, T1 kept.

stav-p04-v38.speaker: Devotee (resting)
stav-p04-v38.question: Where rest from duty-crores?
premises: Having weighed even duty-crores, from mind's fickleness.
Resting, O Bhava, in your mind-bliss I delight greatly.
stav-p04-v38.inference: Resting from countless duties in your mind-bliss, I delight.

option_choices.reason: Possessive your-mind-bliss (resting place); relational concerning-you is same locus, T1 kept.
Present I-delight (resting delight); optative is same wish, T1 kept.

stav-p04-v39.speaker: Devotee (puzzling subtle/gross)
stav-p04-v39.question: How subtle-part yet gross-unseen?
premises: If even subtle, how is this three-world a mere part of you?
If gross, then why not easily seen even by Brahmā and others, O lord?
stav-p04-v39.inference: Subtle yet whole-part; gross yet unseen — how?

option_choices.reason: Mere-part (kalā as portion); moon-digit allusion is same smallness, T1 part kept.
Easily-seen (why not seen by Brahmā); fair-seeming is same visibility, T1 kept.

stav-p04-v40.speaker: Devotee (reasoning word-nets)
stav-p04-v40.question: Who would toil in word-nets?
premises: If this 'you indeed are their expressible' had not been.
What wise one, O god, would then have taken trouble in word-nets?
stav-p04-v40.inference: Without you-as-expressible, no wise one would toil in words.

option_choices.reason: Expressible (predicate of you); to-be-spoken is same gerundive, T1 kept.

stav-p04-v41.speaker: Devotee (begging teaching)
stav-p04-v41.question: By what rite or wisdom are you seen?
premises: By which course, by which rite, or by which wisdom, O lord, are you visible?
By teaching show grace to me.
stav-p04-v41.inference: Show by teaching which course makes you visible; grant grace.

option_choices.reason: By-course/method (means of seeing); gradually is same krama, T1 kept.
By-teaching (means of grace); as-teaching content is same instruction, T1 kept.

stav-p05-v42.speaker: Devotee (bowing)
stav-p05-v42.question: To whom bow — needing nothing, helping all?
premises: Bow to needing-no-service, sole helper of three worlds.
Of all desired, to desireless, to matted-haired.
stav-p05-v42.inference: Bow to desireless helper of all, desired by all.

option_choices.reason: Needing-no-service (self-sufficient); admitting-no-service is same sufficiency, T1 kept.

stav-p05-v43.speaker: Devotee (marveling)
stav-p05-v43.question: What discernment sows devotion?
premises: Ah, this very discernment of the good for the great purpose.
Whereby these sow in you endless-fruited devotion, O lord.
stav-p05-v43.inference: Good discernment sows endless devotion in you.

option_choices.reason: Faculty discernment (field-knowing as capacity); agent knower is same knower, T1 faculty kept.
They-sow (agricultural metaphor of devotion); establish is same planting, T1 sow kept.

stav-p05-v44.speaker: Devotee (marveling at māyā)
stav-p05-v44.question: How does māyā slacken the world?
premises: Ah, great is this māyā of yours, O wielder, veiled by which.
Even on gaining meditation-treasure on you, the bewildered people slacken.
stav-p05-v44.inference: Your great māyā veils even treasure-gainers into slackness.

option_choices.reason: Slackens (grows lax in practice); releases letting-go is same laxity, T1 kept.

stav-p05-v45.speaker: Devotee (asserting agency)
stav-p05-v45.question: Who is the free doer?
premises: In every undertaking, O Bhava — act or means-and-rest or all, let be.
But the free doer therein alone is you.
stav-p05-v45.inference: Amid all acts and means, you alone are the free doer.

option_choices.reason: In-undertaking (occasion of each act); in-beginning temporal is same onset, T1 kept.

stav-p05-v46.speaker: Devotee (pleading rescue)
stav-p05-v46.question: Whose power rescues the seized worlds?
premises: The three worlds seized by three-guṇa triple-throb dualities.
To rescue, other than you, whose is the power — or the grace?
stav-p05-v46.inference: Seized worlds need your power or grace; none other's.

option_choices.reason: Grace-or (alternative to power); or-else is same alternation, T1 kept.

stav-p05-v47.speaker: Devotee (inverting fault and greed)
stav-p05-v47.question: What fault, what greed reaches you?
premises: What fault is fault in one set on reaching you? What virtue in one set on not reaching?
Let passion be mine resting in you alone; bow even to my greed whose prop is gaining you. (Upāya reading belongs to Kṣemarāja, never the root.)
stav-p05-v47.inference: Fault aimed at you is no fault; even greed for you is bow-worthy.

stav-p05-v48.speaker: Devotee (marveling at contemplation)
stav-p05-v48.question: Who is made eligible by contemplation?
premises: Ah, great is this deed, O god, consisting of contemplation on you.
In which from Brahmā to worm, who of us is not made eligible for liberation?
stav-p05-v48.inference: Contemplation on you makes all, worm to Brahmā, eligible.

option_choices.reason: Of-us (nas enclitic, of us with rhetorical who); na-not reading is same negation, T1 of-us kept.

stav-p05-v49.speaker: Devotee (tracing works)
stav-p05-v49.question: Whose are beginning, end, and between?
premises: Beginning of all works, end of all rites.
The various inner happenings between — yours indeed, O lord, on thought's path.
stav-p05-v49.inference: All beginnings, ends, and betweens are yours on thought's path.

option_choices.reason: Various (manifold happenings); bright/strange is same citra, T1 various kept.
Of-thought (genitive singular, on thought's path); nominative thoughts plural is same dhiyaḥ, T1 genitive kept.

stav-p05-v50.speaker: Devotee (tasting)
stav-p05-v50.question: Where is devotion-nectar seen?
premises: While higher thousandfold expanse of taste.
Than your devotion-rasa-nectars, O lord, not elsewhere is seen.
stav-p05-v50.inference: No taste elsewhere exceeds your devotion-nectar.

option_choices.reason: Higher (greater taste); later/answer is same uttara, T1 higher kept.

stav-p06-v51.speaker: Devotee (bowing)
stav-p06-v51.question: To whom bow — desire withdrawn?
premises: To desire-withdrawn, longing-stretched, to-stretching.
To moon-crested, to Soma, to master: bow.
stav-p06-v51.inference: Bow to master Soma, desire withdrawn, moon-crested.

option_choices.reason: Longing-stretched (kāmā + āyati as stretched longing); prolonging is same duration, T1 kept.

stav-p06-v52.speaker: Devotee (taking refuge)
stav-p06-v52.question: What refuge for the incapable?
premises: 'What can I, incapable, do?' — for one resolving nothing anywhere.
All-befriending power, Śaṅkara's: my refuge.
stav-p06-v52.inference: Śaṅkara's all-befriending power is refuge for the resolveless.

option_choices.reason: Same agent; of-resolving-nothing-anywhere kept as T1 genitive.

stav-p06-v53.speaker: Devotee (questioning substitute)
stav-p06-v53.question: What substitute for you?
premises: Of beyond-guṇas, whose self is utter excellence.
In which part, O Bhava, is a substitute of yours found?
stav-p06-v53.inference: No part holds a substitute for you beyond guṇas.

option_choices.reason: Other (substitute other than you); supreme is same para, T1 other kept.
Substitute (standing in); representative is same pratinidhi, T1 kept.

stav-p06-v54.speaker: Devotee (confessing deceit)
stav-p06-v54.question: Why cheated though you are nondual?
premises: In nondual, in limitless — in you, in self being, O lord.
We are cheated even now by your unmeasured māyā.
stav-p06-v54.inference: Though you are nondual self, your māyā cheats us still.

option_choices.reason: Unmeasured (not measured); unfathomable is same ameya, T1 kept.

stav-p06-v55.speaker: Devotee (listing fruits)
stav-p06-v55.question: What sprouts from devotion?
premises: Attainment of powers from aṇimā, eternal lordship, end of becoming.
These, O Bhava, are sprouts of devotion's wish-tree.
stav-p06-v55.inference: Powers, lordship, and end of becoming sprout from devotion.

stav-p06-v56.speaker: Devotee (pleading presence)
stav-p06-v56.question: When will you be won?
premises: Whatever quarter, there never absent; all time made of you.
Thus already won, yet when will you be won, O lord? Tell.
stav-p06-v56.inference: Already won everywhere, yet when won? Tell, O lord.

option_choices.reason: Already-won (labdha, won by us); attained is same winning, T1 kept.

stav-p06-v57.speaker: Devotee (bowing)
stav-p06-v57.question: To whom bow — clear hearts?
premises: Bow to sole dweller in clear good hearts.
White-limbed with much ash, great swan, to Śambhu.
stav-p06-v57.inference: Bow to Śambhu, ash-white swan dwelling in clear hearts.

stav-p06-v58.speaker: Devotee (begging lamps)
stav-p06-v58.question: What lamps be mine?
premises: Dispersing surging darkness, having burned all becoming-fuel.
May your awareness-lamp be mine, O lord — your devotion-lamp.
stav-p06-v58.inference: May awareness- and devotion-lamps burn darkness and fuel.
uncertainties: tānti spread vs weariness — dispersing kept, needs Kṣemarāja check.

option_choices.reason: Dispersing (present action); removal is same hṛta, T1 kept.

stav-p06-v59.speaker: Devotee (marveling at poet)
stav-p06-v59.question: Who but you dissolves the play?
premises: Having staged the three-world-play pregnant with true seeds.
O Hara, to dissolve — who but you is a capable poet?
stav-p06-v59.inference: You staged the play; only you, poet, can dissolve it.

option_choices.reason: Dissolve (the staged play ends); gather-up is same saṃhṛ, T1 kept.
Poet (playwright of worlds); sage is same kavi, T1 poet kept.

stav-p06-v60.speaker: Devotee (bowing)
stav-p06-v60.question: To whom bow — free and unfree?
premises: Bow to make real-and-unreal into non-being or being indeed.
To free and unfree, to embodying-expenditure-and-dominion.
stav-p06-v60.inference: Bow to the free-unfree one embodying loss and lordship.

stav-p07-v61.speaker: Devotee (marveling)
stav-p07-v61.question: Whose drop is all bliss?
premises: Whatever bliss at all is seen here even in three worlds.
That is a drop of whom: to that god, bliss-ocean, I bow.
stav-p07-v61.inference: All seen bliss is a drop of the bliss-ocean god.

stav-p07-v62.speaker: Devotee (praising chanters)
stav-p07-v62.question: Who are blessed?
premises: Ah, blessed Brahmā and others who dropped all other talk.
Mutter overwhelmed with joy: homage, homage to Śiva.
stav-p07-v62.inference: Blessed are those chanting Śiva, dropped all else.

stav-p07-v63.speaker: Devotee (bowing)
stav-p07-v63.question: To whom bow — desireless enjoyer?
premises: To desireless yet ordainer of endless desires.
Even in world's beginninglessness, to enjoyer — O Bhava, let bow be to you.
stav-p07-v63.inference: Bow to desireless ordainer and enjoyer.

stav-p07-v64.speaker: Devotee (reasoning service)
stav-p07-v64.question: Who seeks service from the perfect?
premises: We praise the lord, root-nature of three-world beginning.
Who would seek any service from him, since of perfect nature?
stav-p07-v64.inference: None seeks service from the perfect-natured lord.

option_choices.reason: Causal since (perfect nature, so no service sought); ablative from-whom is same source, T1 since kept.
Nature (perfect being); duty is same dharman, T1 nature kept.

stav-p07-v65.speaker: Devotee (testifying remembrance)
stav-p07-v65.question: What clears deluded minds?
premises: Even in great hard straits, dirtied by delusion-flood.
When he is remembered, minds clear: that Śiva we praise.
stav-p07-v65.inference: Remembrance of Śiva clears deluded minds.

option_choices.reason: They-clear (minds become lucid); gracious is same prasīd, T1 clear kept.

stav-p07-v66.speaker: Devotee (asserting power)
stav-p07-v66.question: Whose power unfolds worlds?
premises: O lord, from you alone here sovereign power unbroken.
By whose will the three worlds' dissolution and rise unfold.
stav-p07-v66.inference: From you alone unbroken power unfolds worlds' rise and fall.

stav-p07-v67.speaker: Devotee (inverting evil and good)
stav-p07-v67.question: What evil becomes supreme good?
premises: Even evil deed aimed at which god would become supreme good.
Even good deed's goodness — since elsewhere you are not so, O!
stav-p07-v67.inference: Evil aimed at you becomes supreme; good is good only by you.

stav-p07-v68.speaker: Devotee (seizing and running)
stav-p07-v68.question: Who runs to Dhūrjaṭi?
premises: 'Seized by fist you are, seen you are — where go you from us?' — thus.
Puffed with devotion-rasa, the blessed run to Dhūrjaṭi.
stav-p07-v68.inference: Devotion-puffed blessed seize and chase Dhūrjaṭi.

option_choices.reason: From-us (ablative, where go from us); genitive of-us is same bond, T1 from-us kept.

stav-p07-v69.speaker: Devotee (praising beyond Veda)
stav-p07-v69.question: Whom praise beyond bright and beyond?
premises: We praise you — of Ṛk-Yajus-Sāman, from bright, from beyond, beyond.
Whose Veda-embodied knowable — ah, deep-lovely.
stav-p07-v69.inference: Praise you beyond Veda, bright, beyond — deep-lovely knowable.
uncertainties: Vṛtti M00089: śukra = vedatraya-para (bodhāditya-tejas); vedātmikā ājñā = command (niyoga) — variant against jñeya (knowable), recorded not smoothed; gambhīrā (few attain) + sundarī (gives bliss-rest).

option_choices.reason: From-bright kept; Vṛtti: śukra = supreme of three Vedas, sun-of-awakening radiance (bodhāditya).
Veda-embodied-knowable kept; Vṛtti ājñā (command) variant recorded in uncertainties.
Deep-lovely kept; Vṛtti: few attain (deep), gives bliss-rest (lovely).

stav-p07-v70.speaker: Devotee (reasoning origin)
stav-p07-v70.question: From where the dharma-multitude?
premises: Rule, beginning, so end you are of the world, O Supreme Lord.
The dharma-multitude set forth: which is not from you — from where would it be?
stav-p07-v70.inference: You are rule, beginning, end; all dharmas are from you.

option_choices.reason: Rule (vidhi as ordinance); Brahmā-ordainer personifies same rule, T1 rule kept.

stav-p08-v71.speaker: Devotee (bowing)
stav-p08-v71.question: To whom bow — breaker and uncoverer?
premises: Bow to you who, having manifested the becoming-agitated delusion, breaks.
To knowledge-bliss, nondual — O god, having covered, to uncoverer.
stav-p08-v71.inference: Bow to breaker and uncoverer of delusion, knowledge-bliss nondual.
uncertainties: Obscure syntax — literal only; bhindate/vivṛṇvate datives, vṛtvā covering.

option_choices.reason: To-breaker (agent breaking delusion); for-breaking purpose is same act, T1 kept.
Having-covered (manifesting then covering); enclosed is same vṛ, T1 kept.

stav-p08-v72.speaker: Devotee (pleading protection)
stav-p08-v72.question: Who protects from māyā?
premises: By which wishes could her end-distinction be reached.
Stealing māyā in one wink — may that Śiva protect us.
stav-p08-v72.inference: May Śiva who steals māyā in a wink protect us.
uncertainties: yasyāḥ antecedent māyā open; paryantaviśeṣaḥ end vs limit.

option_choices.reason: End-distinction (reachability of her end); limit is same paryanta, T1 kept.

stav-p08-v73.speaker: Devotee (acknowledging lordship)
stav-p08-v73.question: Who is lord of dispassion, knowledge, desirelessness?
premises: Weighty course of dispassion, supreme glory of knowledge, highest peak of desirelessness.
Of bearing these, you, O lord, are lord.
stav-p08-v73.inference: You bear dispassion, knowledge, desirelessness: you are lord.

option_choices.reason: Course (way of dispassion); goal is same gati, T1 kept.

stav-p08-v74.speaker: Devotee (questioning measure)
stav-p08-v74.question: How great are you?
premises: Even of Brahmā you are Brahmā; of whom are you not lord, O lord of lords.
World-welfare's welfare, how great you are — who knows?
stav-p08-v74.inference: Lord of lords beyond measure — who knows how great?

option_choices.reason: Of-Brahmā (god, with Brahmā predicate); absolute brahman is same word, T1 god kept.

stav-p08-v75.speaker: Devotee (renouncing kin)
stav-p08-v75.question: What use kin and masters?
premises: What with other kin, what with friends and masters likewise.
In every place, my lord, you lift from the becoming-ocean.
stav-p08-v75.inference: No kin or master; you alone lift everywhere.

stav-p08-v76.speaker: Devotee (exulting nectar)
stav-p08-v76.question: What drops conquer?
premises: Victorious drops of divine nectar.
Drawn by Śaiva-yoga power, able to wash delusion-māyā stain. (Kṣemarāja skips the śaivayoga allusion — elucidated, not smoothed.)
stav-p08-v76.inference: Śaiva-yoga-drawn nectar drops conquer, washing stain.

option_choices.reason: Victory-exclamation (jayanti); finite they-conquer is same victory, T1 kept.
Drops (vipruṣ as drops); sprinklings is same scattering, T1 kept.

stav-p08-v77.speaker: Devotee (chanting Gāyatrī)
stav-p08-v77.question: Who impels thoughts on the true path?
premises: By Gāyatrī is sung whose thought-radiance impelling.
May he impel, I hope, our thoughts on the true path, the lord.
stav-p08-v77.inference: May Gāyatrī-sung impeller guide thoughts truly.

stav-p08-v78.speaker: Devotee (begging standing)
stav-p08-v78.question: Will you not make standing?
premises: O eight-formed, in even one form will you not make eternal standing for us.
Or pleased, you will do all.
stav-p08-v78.inference: Make eternal standing in one form; pleased, do all.

stav-p08-v79.speaker: Devotee (trusting name)
stav-p08-v79.question: What gives liberation?
premises: Reality-principle of categories generally effects purpose.
But yours, O lord, even the name gives accomplishment up to liberation.
stav-p08-v79.inference: Things effect purposes; your name gives liberation.

stav-p08-v80.speaker: Devotee (marveling at power)
stav-p08-v80.question: Who is not amazed at your power?
premises: Again and again, to arrange each next state of the world-picture.
By that power of yours, O lord, what mindful one is not amazed?
stav-p08-v80.inference: Your ever-arranging power amazes every mindful one.

option_choices.reason: To-arrange (each next state set); conceive/infer is same ūh, T1 arrange kept; hyphen token byte-exact.

stav-p09-v81.speaker: Devotee (remembering)
stav-p09-v81.question: Whom remember?
premises: To make hard easy, to gladden suffering likewise.
Sole-heroic is whose remembrance: him we remember, love's foe.
stav-p09-v81.inference: Remember love's foe, whose remembrance conquers hardship.

stav-p09-v82.speaker: Devotee (exulting songs)
stav-p09-v82.question: Whose songs conquer?
premises: Victorious songs whose singable is the supreme lord.
By whose name even great souls are sown with thrill-sprouts.
stav-p09-v82.inference: Songs of the supreme lord conquer, thrilling great souls.

option_choices.reason: Victory-exclamation (songs conquer); finite plural same victory, T1 kept.
Are-sown (thrill-sprouts sown); scattered same strewing, T1 sown kept.

stav-p09-v83.speaker: Devotee (supposing identity)
stav-p09-v83.question: What if you were indeed you?
premises: As you, indeed you would be, if supreme — O Bhava.
Whose three-world-beginning-dissolution is arrayed by own power formations.
stav-p09-v83.inference: If supreme, you are arrayed beginning-dissolution by own power.

option_choices.reason: Supreme (if supreme you); further same para, T1 supreme kept.

stav-p09-v84.speaker: Devotee (begging mantra)
stav-p09-v84.question: What mantra that I be yours?
premises: Mantra you are, counsel-worthy you are, counsellor — whence another than you?
He — to me give that mantra, so that I may be your mantra, O lord.
stav-p09-v84.inference: You are mantra and counsellor; give that mantra making me yours.

option_choices.reason: Counsel-worthy (fit to advise); to-be-consulted same mantraṇīya, T1 kept.

stav-p09-v85.speaker: Devotee (puzzling identity)
stav-p09-v85.question: How dream in you?
premises: Light-formed, true-resolve, you are the self of whom — even he am I.
'Transmigrator' thus — what, O lord, is this — that dream even, whence in you?
stav-p09-v85.inference: You are self of whom I am; yet transmigrator-dream — whence?
uncertainties: Highly compressed identity wordplay (yasya…saḥ…aham; saṃsārī iti; svapnaḥ) — literal only, needs Kṣemarāja at L0/argmap.

stav-p09-v86.speaker: Devotee (naming lordship)
stav-p09-v86.question: Whose is unbroken coherent lordship?
premises: That unbroken, that unvulgar, that one, coherent.
In you, O lord, is the lordship of those who entrust work-fruits.
stav-p09-v86.inference: Unbroken coherent lordship is in you, of fruit-entrusters.

option_choices.reason: Unvulgar (refined, not crude); not-rustic same a-grāmya, T1 kept.
Coherent (hanging together); possessing-proof same upapatti, T1 kept.

stav-p09-v87.speaker: Devotee (praising capable beloved)
stav-p09-v87.question: What can he not destroy or give?
premises: Capable — what misfortune not to destroy, what fortune not to give, or.
Who is that-one: he is our beloved, god of gods, bull-bannered.
stav-p09-v87.inference: Our beloved bull-bannered can destroy all ills, give all fortunes.

stav-p09-v88.speaker: Devotee (applying ointment)
stav-p09-v88.question: What purifies the knowledge-eye?
premises: For the divine knowledge-eye blinded by māyā-made stain.
In purifying, O lord, devotion to you is the supreme ointment.
stav-p09-v88.inference: Devotion to you is supreme ointment purifying the blinded eye.

stav-p09-v89.speaker: Devotee (begging state)
stav-p09-v89.question: Why wait to give the state?
premises: Fearless, bliss-constituted, one, imperishable — give the state, come to me, O god.
Quickly — why wait for that?
stav-p09-v89.inference: Give the fearless bliss-state quickly; why wait?

option_choices.reason: State (pada as condition to give); place/foot same pada, T1 state kept.

stav-p09-v90.speaker: Devotee (marveling ocean and crosser)
stav-p09-v90.question: What ocean, what crosser?
premises: Ah, naturally deep, dreadful is the transmigration-ocean.
Ah, the means to cross it — the supreme someone — great lord.
stav-p09-v90.inference: Dreadful ocean; supreme someone great lord crosses it.

option_choices.reason: Supreme (para as highest someone); other same para, T1 supreme kept.

stav-p10-v91.speaker: Devotee (bowing)
stav-p10-v91.question: To whom bow — death-ender?
premises: Bow to you, ender of death, crusher of love.
Gaṅgā on head, doer of what is right as fitting.
stav-p10-v91.inference: Bow to death-ending love-crusher, Gaṅgā-crowned righter.

stav-p10-v92.speaker: Devotee (asking resort)
stav-p10-v92.question: What higher resort without you?
premises: Above even lordship, knowledge, dispassion, dharmas — the standing prayed for.
Without you, O lord, what higher resort for those praying?
stav-p10-v92.inference: No higher resort than you above all attainments.

stav-p10-v93.speaker: Devotee (marveling will)
stav-p10-v93.question: Who bends grass, carries Brahmā's yoke?
premises: When you do not will, who is capable, O Śambhu, to bend grass?
But favoured by your will — who would not carry Brahmā's yoke?
stav-p10-v93.inference: Without your will none bends grass; with it all carry Brahmā's yoke.

option_choices.reason: To-bend (grass bent); hunch same kubjaya, T1 bend kept.

stav-p10-v94.speaker: Devotee (asking homage)
stav-p10-v94.question: To what supreme would wisdom bow?
premises: Heads raised with jewel-crowns of bowing to Hara — the wisdom-rich.
To what supreme would they bow, or whom would they not bend?
stav-p10-v94.inference: Wisdom-rich bow to no supreme but Hara-crowned heads' lord.

option_choices.reason: Supreme (what supreme); other same para, T1 supreme kept.

stav-p10-v95.speaker: Devotee (dwelling)
stav-p10-v95.question: Where dwell?
premises: Tremorless, shed of all wandering, nectar-lake.
The middle of your knowledge-ocean — may I dwell upon, O Dhūrjaṭi.
stav-p10-v95.inference: May I dwell in your knowledge-ocean's tremorless middle.

stav-p10-v96.speaker: Devotee (marveling grant)
stav-p10-v96.question: How grant ultimate fruit?
premises: Wonder that — even strangely seen, even gone into wish.
Ultimate fruit, O lord, full you grant.
stav-p10-v96.inference: Strangely seen or wished, you grant full ultimate fruit — wonder.

option_choices.reason: Strangely-seen (odd manner of seeing); seen-as-wonder same citra, T1 kept.

stav-p10-v97.speaker: Devotee (bewildered praising)
stav-p10-v97.question: Praise or blame you?
premises: Who is greater than you by virtues? Who attributeless greater than you?
Thus, O lord, we laud — do we praise you? Do we blame? We do not think.
stav-p10-v97.inference: None greater virtned or virtneless; praise or blame — we do not know.

option_choices.reason: We-laud (nu praise); bow same homage, T1 laud kept.

stav-p10-v98.speaker: Devotee (thirsting nectar)
stav-p10-v98.question: Who drinks, who gives nectar-fruit?
premises: Even in praising, of the nectar-flood — of which favour is your fruit.
That to drink, who else is capable — how much more to give, O world-lord?
stav-p10-v98.inference: None can drink your nectar-fruit, much less give it, but you.

option_choices.reason: Favour (grace whose fruit); clarity same prasatti, T1 favour kept.

stav-p10-v99.speaker: Devotee (praying devotion)
stav-p10-v99.question: What pray from the treasury?
premises: From treasury of accomplishment of wholly desirable hosts.
From you, devotion to you alone to obtain I pray, O lord, in every way.
stav-p10-v99.inference: From all-desire treasury, pray only devotion to you.

stav-p10-v100.speaker: Devotee (bowing to power)
stav-p10-v100.question: To what unimpeded power bow?
premises: Bow to three-world-lord, to you, O Bhava.
Of those attending you — to unimpeded power giving three-world-lordship.
stav-p10-v100.inference: Bow to unimpeded three-world-lordship power of your attendants' lord.

stav-p11-v101.speaker: Devotee (deciding refuge)
stav-p11-v101.question: Who has not gone to refuge?
premises: Of abandoning all suffering the cause who — when in such doubt.
O master, 'he you are' having decided — who has not gone to you as refuge?
stav-p11-v101.inference: Deciding 'he you are', all take refuge; none has not.

stav-p11-v102.speaker: Devotee (hoping shine)
stav-p11-v102.question: May hope shine in Śambhu?
premises: Having enjoyed enjoyments, having dropped becoming-delusion, I will attain the supreme state.
Thus the hope here: may it shine supremely of the devout in Śambhu.
stav-p11-v102.inference: Enjoyed and dropped, may attainment-hope shine in Śambhu.

stav-p11-v103.speaker: Devotee (content in dependence)
stav-p11-v103.question: What do or say in dream?
premises: O lord, even in dream whatever I may do or say, good or bad.
With pride of dependence on you — everywhere here I am content.
stav-p11-v103.inference: Dependent-pride makes every dream act content.

stav-p11-v104.speaker: Devotee (declaring impossibility)
stav-p11-v104.question: What touch of darkness?
premises: Of lights even which light — there in your abode of the running mind.
O lord of mind, touch of darkness — I think, barren-woman's-son's-younger-brother.
stav-p11-v104.inference: Darkness touching your abode-mind is impossible.

stav-p11-v105.speaker: Devotee (thinking service)
stav-p11-v105.question: Whose wish stands on the path?
premises: I think, foot placed even on the benign path of liberation.
Stands whose wish: 'I will serve Śiva' — this.
stav-p11-v105.inference: The serving-Śiva wish stands placed on liberation's path.

stav-p11-v106.speaker: Devotee (acknowledging power)
stav-p11-v106.question: Whose free power oversees the loom?
premises: By maintenance, origin, dissolutions, in services of three worlds here.
Alone indeed, O lord, your power — free — the loom you oversee.
stav-p11-v106.inference: Your alone free power oversees the three-world loom.

option_choices.reason: Free (predicate of power); as-free adverbial same freedom, T1 kept.
You-oversee (loom supervised); consider same īkṣ, T1 oversee kept.

stav-p11-v107.speaker: Devotee (bowing to lake)
stav-p11-v107.question: To which extinction-lake bow?
premises: In three worlds here who is saved, by triple suffering not afflicted.
To him let bow be, to you — who you are that extinction-nectar-lake.
stav-p11-v107.inference: Bow to you, extinction-nectar-lake saving from triple pain.

stav-p11-v108.speaker: Devotee (questioning fruit)
stav-p11-v108.question: What-fruited if guileless?
premises: Even artificial devotion to you has genuine fruit arising.
If this were guileless, what-fruited — by you let it be said.
stav-p11-v108.inference: Artificial devotion fruits; guileless — what fruit? You say.

stav-p11-v109.speaker: Devotee (naming eye and way)
stav-p11-v109.question: What eye sees, what way reaches?
premises: That eye by which you are seen, that way by which you are reached.
That fruit, O unborn, is born — from wish-tree of talk about you.
stav-p11-v109.inference: Seeing-eye and reaching-way fruit from talk's wish-tree.

stav-p11-v110.speaker: Devotee (taking refuge)
stav-p11-v110.question: Who removes obstacles?
premises: Better than good indeed is this — above, in you, which standing.
For removing obstacles to that, you, O lord, are my refuge.
stav-p11-v110.inference: You are refuge removing obstacles to standing in you.

stav-p12-v111.speaker: Devotee (tasting)
stav-p12-v111.question: Where ceaselessly fresh?
premises: Ah, sweetest is the nectar-taste of hoping to serve Śarva.
Where in a mere digit of time does it not become ever-fresh?
stav-p12-v111.inference: Service-hope's nectar is ever-fresh at every instant.

stav-p12-v112.speaker: Devotee (exulting victory)
stav-p12-v112.question: Who conquers untiring?
premises: Again and again untiring, three worlds with hundreds of imaginings imagining even.
Who yet one, undifferentiated, conquers — unborn.
stav-p12-v112.inference: Untiring imaginer, one, undifferentiated, unborn conquers.

option_choices.reason: Conquers (3sg conquers imagining); victory-exclamation same jayati, T1 kept.

stav-p12-v113.speaker: Devotee (pleading presence)
stav-p12-v113.question: When present to you?
premises: By the knowledge-lamp burning the wick of transmigration-latencies anointed with stain-oil.
O god, when to you may I be present, pray?
stav-p12-v113.inference: By knowledge-lamp burning latencies, may I be present to you?

stav-p12-v114.speaker: Devotee (bargaining wink)
stav-p12-v114.question: What will you not accomplish?
premises: Even one wink, if fault-waned you make foot in mind.
Then, O Śambhu, what will you not accomplish?
stav-p12-v114.inference: One faultless wink of mind-foot accomplishes all.

option_choices.reason: Foot (make foot/step in mind); state/condition same pada, T1 foot kept.

stav-p12-v115.speaker: Devotee (claiming blessedness)
stav-p12-v115.question: Whose conviction stands?
premises: 'Blessed I am, duty done I am, great I am' — thus conviction.
Would be with-support — his who has you as support, O lord.
stav-p12-v115.inference: Blessed-done-great conviction stands supported by you.

option_choices.reason: With-support (grounded conviction); supported same sālambana, T1 kept.

stav-p12-v116.speaker: Devotee (distinguishing mothers)
stav-p12-v116.question: What mothers only auspicious?
premises: Of all auspicious and inauspicious yourself the doer you are.
But devotion to you is mother of auspicious alone, O lord, only.
stav-p12-v116.inference: You do all; devotion mothers only auspicious.

stav-p12-v117.speaker: Devotee (swinging in doubt)
stav-p12-v117.question: Do you enter, or does it clear?
premises: When mind is clear, O master — do you enter, or from your entering does it clear.
Thus the person swings.
stav-p12-v117.inference: Entering vs clearing — the person swings between.

stav-p12-v118.speaker: Devotee (resolving certainty)
stav-p12-v118.question: What certainty, accomplishment, state?
premises: But this certainty here — supervision by you alone indeed.
Grace of mind, O master — that is accomplishment, that supreme state. (Resolves v117 swing.)
stav-p12-v118.inference: Certainty: supervised by you alone; grace is accomplishment, supreme state.

option_choices.reason: Supervision-by-you (adhiṣṭhāna oversight resolving doubt); support same resting, T1 kept.
Grace (prasāda favour); clarity same clearing, T1 grace kept.

stav-p12-v119.speaker: Devotee (offering all)
stav-p12-v119.question: What be ornamented?
premises: Speech and mind and deed and my body — which, O lord.
By your grace may that be ornamented alone with devotion to you.
stav-p12-v119.inference: May speech, mind, deed, body be ornamented with devotion.

stav-p12-v120.speaker: Bhaṭṭanārāyaṇa (colophon)
stav-p12-v120.question: Who made this wish-jewel?
premises: The wish-jewel of praise, giving rich fruits of wishes.
Abode of devotion's fortune — O Śambhu — Bhaṭṭanārāyaṇa made.
stav-p12-v120.inference: Bhaṭṭanārāyaṇa made this devotion-jewel for Śambhu.

stav-p00-v01.plain_english: Through honeyed lips that ravish thought, through seer and the seen — triumphs the lord whose might is bliss displayed — high God.
stav-p00-v01.sanskrit_cite: sugirā cittahāriṇyā paśyantyā dṛśyamānayā jayaty ullāsitānandamahimā parameśvaraḥ

stav-p01-v02.plain_english: Who, grown great with the wealth of glory, compassion, awakening, and supreme bliss, his greatness lit by knowledge — he conquers, the undefeated.
stav-p01-v02.sanskrit_cite: yaḥ sphītaḥ śrīdayābodhaparamānandasampadā vidyoddyotitamāhātmyaḥ sa jayaty aparājitaḥ

stav-p01-v03.plain_english: To the forth-flowing drop and resonance, to the self made of pure nectar: bow; to endless light, to Śaṅkara, the milk-ocean.

stav-p01-v04.plain_english: You we hate, you we hymn, with you we counsel — O Ambikā’s lord: lightly won, how good — the whole world you have borne for us.
stav-p01-v04.sanskrit_cite: dviṣmas tvāṃ tvāṃ stumas tubhyaṃ mantrayāmo 'mbikāpate ativāllabhyataḥ sādhu viśvaṅ no dhṛtavān asi

stav-p01-v05.plain_english: To the yoked withdrawn touch, to the full-streamed nectar, to the sky-and-māyā-formed: to the vast one, to Śambhu — bow.
stav-p01-v05.sanskrit_cite: saṃhṛtasparśayogāya sampūrṇāmṛtasūtaye viyanmāyāsvarūpāya vibhave śambhave namaḥ

stav-p01-v06.plain_english: Among the split, not split; among the cut, wholly uncut — we bow to that all-common form of the supreme Lord.
stav-p01-v06.sanskrit_cite: bhinneṣv api na bhinnaṃ yac chinneṣv achinnam eva ca namāmaḥ sarvasāmānyaṃ rūpaṃ tat pārameśvaram

stav-p01-v07.plain_english: Subtler than praṇava's upper half-mora — to the minute, and again to the great; vaster than the world-egg — to the qualified-by-qualitylessness, to Sthāṇu: bow.
stav-p01-v07.sanskrit_cite: praṇavordhvārdhamātrāto 'py aṇave mahate punaḥ brahmāṇḍād api nairguṇyaguṇāya sthāṇave namaḥ

stav-p01-v08.plain_english: The world-egg-bearing one — of the sky-pervading, of the all-going, of the supreme-Lord-goose — that power, goose-like, we praise.
stav-p01-v08.sanskrit_cite: brahmāṇḍagarbhiṇīṃ vyomavyāpinaḥ sarvatogateḥ parameśvarahaṃsasya śaktiṃ haṃsīm iva stumaḥ

stav-p01-v09.plain_english: With no provision of material, on no wall at all, they spread the world-picture — bow to him, the art-praised trident-bearer.
stav-p01-v09.sanskrit_cite: nirupādānasambhāram abhittāv eva tanvate jagaccitraṃ namas tasmai kalāślāghyāya śūline

stav-p01-v10.plain_english: From māyā's watery belly fully drawn out and made stainless — Śiva-knowledge, milked of itself: give, come, O Hara-goose, to us.
stav-p01-v10.sanskrit_cite: māyājalodarāt samyag uddhṛtya vimalīkṛtam śivajñānaṃ svato dugdhaṃ dehy ehi harahaṃsa naḥ

stav-p01-v11.plain_english: Even in the yoga of six-valid-means' delimitations and difference: to the undivided; to the one being of ultimate truth — an offering we bring, to Bhava, to you.
stav-p01-v11.sanskrit_cite: ṣaṭpramāṇīparicchedabhedayoge 'py abhedine paramārthaikabhāvāya baliṃ yāmo bhavāya te

stav-p02-v12.plain_english: May we see the deep — circled by supreme light, its darkness wiped, lovely — and dwell within your cave.
stav-p02-v12.sanskrit_cite: api paśyema gambhīrāṃ pareṇa jyotiṣābhitaḥ unmṛṣṭatamasaṃ ramyām antarbhava bhavadguhām

stav-p02-v13.plain_english: Homage to them even — who see the moon-crested lord, giver of supreme bliss, even in dream.
stav-p02-v13.sanskrit_cite: namas tebhyo 'pi ye somakalākalitaśekharam nāthaṃ svapne 'pi paśyanti paramānandadāyinam

stav-p02-v14.plain_english: O Blessed — be! — the desire to contemplate your-ish being, skilled at cutting rebirth-fear: to whom is it not pleasing?
stav-p02-v14.sanskrit_cite: bhagavan bhava bhāvatkaṃ bhāvaṃ bhāvayituṃ ruciḥ punarbhavabhayocchedadakṣā kasmai na rocate

stav-p02-v15.plain_english: Lifelong, O world-lord, let this be our task: staying, by your grace, with mind single-pointed on you alone.
stav-p02-v15.sanskrit_cite: yāvajjīvaṃ jagannātha kartavyam idam astu naḥ tvatprasādāt tvadekāgramanaskatvena yā sthitiḥ

stav-p02-v16.plain_english: To the self made of thousand-branch-spread Veda and Āgama: bow; to Śambhu, the wish-tree of endless fruit.

stav-p02-v17.plain_english: Having entrusted speech, mind, body's acts in you, O Lord — become you-made, pair-free: may we be, at any time?
stav-p02-v17.sanskrit_cite: vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmāṇi viniyojya tvayi prabho tvanmayībhūya nirdvandvāḥ kaccit syāmāpi karhicit

stav-p02-v18.plain_english: In the creation-and-dissolution appointments for each welfare of worlds — to the independently powerful, to the trident-bearer: bow.

stav-p02-v19.plain_english: Of the chief meditation-object past guṇa-yoga, of Dhūrjaṭi — even the name: for meditators, by meditations, what fruit by other supports?
stav-p02-v19.sanskrit_cite: vyatītaguṇayogasya mukhyadhyeyasya dhūrjaṭeḥ nāmāpi dhyāyatāṃ dhyānaiḥ kim anyālambanaiḥ phalam

stav-p02-v20.plain_english: Bow, bow — 'to Śiva' thus said: by mantra-power taking refuge, praiseworthy they who strive to enjoy Śāmbhavī fortune.
stav-p02-v20.sanskrit_cite: namo namaḥ śivāyeti mantrasāmarthyam āśritāḥ ślāghyās te śāmbhavīṃ bhūtim upabhoktuṃ ya udyatāḥ

stav-p02-v21.plain_english: What path by which unattainable? What speech by which unspoken? What meditation by which unmeditated? What — what are you not, O Lord?
stav-p02-v21.sanskrit_cite: kaḥ panthā yena na prāpyaḥ kā ca vāṅ nocyase yayā kiṃ dhyānaṃ yena na dhyeyaḥ kiṃ vā kiṃ nāsi yat prabho

stav-p03-v22.plain_english: Worshipped this, meditated this, pleased this — thus this rasa: by thousand streams, in you, my — O Bhava — may it grow.
stav-p03-v22.sanskrit_cite: arcito 'yam ayaṃ dhyāta eṣa toṣita ity ayam rasaḥ srotaḥsahasreṇa tvayi me bhava vardhatām

stav-p03-v23.plain_english: Bow to the self abode of intellect-lords' garland; to the Lord, to Sthāṇu, to you — serpent-sacrifice-thread-wearing.
stav-p03-v23.sanskrit_cite: namo niḥśeṣadhīpatrimālālayamayātmane nāthāya sthāṇave tubhyaṃ nāgayajñopavītine

stav-p03-v24.plain_english: Of ignorance-darkness, the one medicine: remembrance of you; O Bhava, by its giving let grace be done in me.
stav-p03-v24.sanskrit_cite: ajñānatimirasyaikam auṣadhaṃ saṃsmṛtis tava bhava tattatpradānena prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mayi

stav-p03-v25.plain_english: Bow to Īśa, fulfiller of all human ends; to-be-offered — the homage even — whose here, of the wise?
stav-p03-v25.sanskrit_cite: nama īśāya niḥśeṣapuruṣārthaprasādhakaḥ praṇantavyaḥ praṇāmo 'pi yadīya iha dhīmatām

stav-p03-v26.plain_english: By the immersed in the terrible bhava-ocean, abode of suffering-fish — having obtained Śārva's devotion-jewel: what not conquered?
stav-p03-v26.sanskrit_cite: magnair bhīme bhavāmbhodhau nilaye duḥkhayādasām bhakticintāmaṇiṃ śārvaṃ tataḥ prāpya na kiṃ jitam

stav-p03-v27.plain_english: Of unobstructed, pairless, steady knowledge-wealth: to-be-known you are indeed — who even are these who know you, O Dhūrjaṭi?
stav-p03-v27.sanskrit_cite: nirāvaraṇanirdvandvaniścalajñānasampadām jñeyo 'si kila ke 'py ete ye tvāṃ jānanti dhūrjaṭe

stav-p03-v28.plain_english: Qualityless even — of quality-knowers the to-be-known, one conquers, the unborn; desireless even, by nature — who is desires' supreme fruit.
stav-p03-v28.sanskrit_cite: nirguṇo 'pi guṇajñānāṃ jñeya eko jayaty ajaḥ niṣkāmo 'pi prakṛtyā yaḥ kāmanānāṃ paraṃ phalam

stav-p03-v29.plain_english: For Śrī-jewel-nectar gain, labored where not by which gods? That milk-ocean lordship: yours alone, natural, O Lord.
stav-p03-v29.sanskrit_cite: śrīratnāmṛtalābhāya kliṣṭaṃ yatra na kaiḥ suraiḥ tat kṣīrodadam aiśvaryaṃ tavaiva sahajaṃ vibho

stav-p03-v30.plain_english: Bow — by devotion, for men's liberation, he blossoms: O Bhava, to you, O Protector — by remembrance and praise they give to Śambhu: bliss in bhava, in non-bhava.
stav-p03-v30.sanskrit_cite: namo bhaktyā nṛṇāṃ muktyai bhavate bhava te 'vate smṛtyā nutyā ca dadate śambhave śaṃ bhave 'bhave

stav-p03-v31.plain_english: All-knowing, all-doing, all you are — thus, of knowers: what knowable, what karma, O lord — for endlessness, offered by you?
stav-p03-v31.sanskrit_cite: sarvajñaḥ sarvakṛt sarvam asīti jñānaśālinām vedyaṃ kiṃ karma vā nātha nānantyāya tvayārpyate

stav-p04-v32.plain_english: This whole of three worlds fruits from mere will of yours alone — who, O lord, knows the reach of your workings?
stav-p04-v32.sanskrit_cite: icchāyā eva yasyeyat phalaṃ lokatrayātmakam tasya te nātha kāryāṇāṃ ko vetti kiyatī gatiḥ

stav-p04-v33.plain_english: To him I bow, by whose stairway of works even Brahmā and the rest climb higher and higher to win the abode.
stav-p04-v33.sanskrit_cite: brahmādayo 'pi tad yasya karmasopānamālayā upary upari dhāvanti labdhuṃ dhāma namāmi tam

stav-p04-v34.plain_english: 'Here is Brahmā, here the Great Indra, here sun and moon' — so his power-vine stands in bloom: may Bhava, that one, guard us.
stav-p04-v34.sanskrit_cite: ayaṃ brahmā mahendro 'yaṃ sūryācandramasāv imau iti śaktilatā yasya puṣpitā pātv asau bhavaḥ

stav-p04-v35.plain_english: Deluded hearts find no delusion in him; far-rangers never reach his end — hard ground at dusk: Mṛḍa we praise.
stav-p04-v35.sanskrit_cite: bhramo na labhyate yasya bhrāntāntaḥkaraṇair api dūragair api yasyānto durgam astaṃ stumo mṛḍam

stav-p04-v36.plain_english: Homage in hymn and memory, in meditation, sight, touch, and likewise in arrival — to the beloved mass of bliss, the matted-haired.
stav-p04-v36.sanskrit_cite: namaḥ stutau smṛtau dhyāne darśane sparśane tathā prāptau cānandavṛndāya dayitāya kapardine

stav-p04-v37.plain_english: Thinking in mind, 'why this pride?', O highest Lord — 'proud, I am made of you' — ah me, not in myself: what joy is this?
stav-p04-v37.sanskrit_cite: kiṃ smayeneti matvāpi manasā parameśvara smayena tvanmayo 'smīti māmi nātmani kiṃ mudā

stav-p04-v38.plain_english: Pondered though crores of duties be, through mind's restlessness — I rest, O Bhava, and revel deeply in the bliss of mind in you.
stav-p04-v38.sanskrit_cite: cintayitvāpi kartavyakoṭīś cittasya cāpalāt viśrāmyan bhava bhāvatkacittānande rame bhṛśam

stav-p04-v39.plain_english: Subtle though you be, how is this triple world a mere fragment of yours? Gross though you be, why do even Brahmā and the rest not plainly see you, O lord?
stav-p04-v39.sanskrit_cite: sūkṣmo 'pi cet trilokīyaṃ kalāmātraṃ kathaṃ tava sthūlo 'tha kiṃ sudarśo na brahmādibhir api prabho

stav-p04-v40.plain_english: Had it never been that 'you alone speak them all' — which sage, O god, would ever have strained through tangled words?
stav-p04-v40.sanskrit_cite: vācya eṣāṃ tvam eveti nābhaviṣyad idaṃ yadi kaḥ kleśaṃ deva vāgjāleṣv akariṣyat sudhīs tadā

stav-p04-v41.plain_english: Through what practice, what rite, what wisdom does one behold you, O lord — teach me, and let your favour fall on me.
stav-p04-v41.sanskrit_cite: krameṇa karmaṇā kena kayā vā prajñayā prabho dṛśyo 'sīty upadeśena prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mama

stav-p05-v42.plain_english: I bow to the unserved servitor of all three worlds; to him whom all crave, who craves nothing, the matted hair.
stav-p05-v42.sanskrit_cite: namo nirupakāryāya trailokyaikopakāriṇe sarvasya spṛhaṇīyāya niḥspṛhāya kapardine

stav-p05-v43.plain_english: Ah, see the good ones' discernment for that high task — how they sow undying-fruited love in you, O lord.
stav-p05-v43.sanskrit_cite: aho kṣetrajñatā seyaṃ kāryāya mahate satām yayānantaphalāṃ bhaktiṃ vapanti tvayy amī prabho

stav-p05-v44.plain_english: Ah, vast is that glamour of yours, O trickster — shrouded in it, the dazed folk turn slack though the hoard of thought on you lie gained.
stav-p05-v44.sanskrit_cite: mahatīyam aho māyā tava māyin yayāvṛtaḥ tvaddhyānanidhilābhe 'pi mugdho lokaḥ ślathāyate

stav-p05-v45.plain_english: Let every venture start, O Bhava — deed, instrument, world, what you will — yet the deed's free master there is you alone.
stav-p05-v45.sanskrit_cite: ārambhe bhava sarvatra karma vā karaṇādi vā viśvam astu svatantras tu kartā tatraikako bhavān

stav-p05-v46.plain_english: Gripped are the triple worlds in triple-gun throbbing pairs — to haul them out, besides you whose might, whose mercy?
stav-p05-v46.sanskrit_cite: triguṇatriparispandadvandvagrastaṃ jagattrayam uddhartuṃ bhavato 'nyasya kasya śaktiḥ kṛpāthavā

stav-p05-v47.plain_english: What blame is blame in a man bent on winning you, even O god? What worth is worth, pray, in a man bent on never winning you? Be passion mine, world-lord, fastened on you alone — and homage even to my greed, leashed to gaining you.
stav-p05-v47.sanskrit_cite: doṣo 'pideva ko doṣas tvām āptuṃ yaḥ samāsthitaḥ guṇo 'pi ca guṇaḥ ko nu tvāṃ nāptuṃ yaḥ samāsthitaḥ rāgo 'py astu jagannātha mama tvayy eva yaḥ sthitaḥ lobhāyāpi namas tasmai tvallābhālambanāya me

stav-p05-v48.plain_english: Ah, mighty is this rite, O god — thinking on you: wherein from Brahmā down to the worm, which of us lacks title to release?
stav-p05-v48.sanskrit_cite: aho mahad idaṃ karma deva tvadbhāvanātmakam ābrahmakrimi yasmin no muktaye 'dhikriyeta kaḥ

stav-p05-v49.plain_english: The start of every work, the close of every rite, the shifting play between — all yours indeed, O lord, along wisdom's road.
stav-p05-v49.sanskrit_cite: ārambhaḥ sarvakāryāṇāṃ paryantaḥ sarvakarmaṇām tadantarvṛttayaś citrās tavaiveśo dhiyaḥ pathi

stav-p05-v50.plain_english: As higher rises the thousandfold tide of savour — nowhere but in love's nectar-liqueur for you, O lord, is it found.
stav-p05-v50.sanskrit_cite: yāvad uttaram āsvādasahasraguṇavistaraḥ tvadbhaktirasapīyūṣān nātha nānyatra dṛśyate

stav-p06-v51.plain_english: Homage to Soma master — his longing drawn in, desire stretched long, the moon his crest.
stav-p06-v51.sanskrit_cite: upasaṃhṛtakāmāya kāmāyatim atanvate avataṃsitasomāya somāya svāmine namaḥ

stav-p06-v52.plain_english: Crying 'incapable, what can I do?' with nowhere a resolve to stand on — Śaṅkara's grace that befriends all is where I hide.
stav-p06-v52.sanskrit_cite: kim aśaktaḥ karomīti sarvatrānadhyavasyataḥ sarvānugrāhikā śaktiḥ śāṃkarī śaraṇaṃ mama

stav-p06-v53.plain_english: You stand past the strands, yourself proclaimed sheer wonder — in what corner, Bhava, could a second you be found?
stav-p06-v53.sanskrit_cite: guṇātītasya nirdiṣṭaniḥśeṣātiśayātmanaḥ labhyate bhava kutrāṃśe paraḥ pratinidhis tava

stav-p06-v54.plain_english: Nondual you are, boundless self, O lord — and still your fathomless glamour fools us now.
stav-p06-v54.sanskrit_cite: nirdvandve nirupādhau ca tvayy ātmani sati prabho vayaṃ vañcyāmahe 'dyāpi māyayāmeyayā tava

stav-p06-v55.plain_english: Powers from the minute on, undying lordship, becoming's end — Bhava, these are green shoots of the prayer-tree rooted in you.
stav-p06-v55.sanskrit_cite: aṇimādiguṇāvāptiḥ sadaiśvaryaṃ bhavakṣayaḥ amī bhava bhavadbhaktikalpapādapapallavāḥ

stav-p06-v56.plain_english: No direction lacks you; all hours are your stuff — won already, yet when, lord, shall I win you? Speak.
stav-p06-v56.sanskrit_cite: yā yā dik tatra na kvāsi sarvaḥ kālo bhavanmayaḥ iti labdho 'pi karhi tvaṃ lapsyase nātha kathyatām

stav-p06-v57.plain_english: Homage, Śambhu — lone tenant of lucid honest hearts, ash-white limbs, high swan.

stav-p06-v58.plain_english: Scatter the surging gloom, burn every stick of becoming — be my lamp of waking, lord, my lamp of love.
stav-p06-v58.sanskrit_cite: hṛtoddhatatamastāntiḥ pluṣṭāśeṣabhavendhanā tvadbodhadīpikā me 'stu nātha tvadbhaktidīpikā

stav-p06-v59.plain_english: You set the triple-world drama teeming with live seed — Hara, to strike the set, what playwright but you has skill?
stav-p06-v59.sanskrit_cite: visṛṣṭānekasadbījagarbhaṃ trailokyanāṭakam prastāvya hara saṃhartuṃ tvattaḥ ko 'nyaḥ kaviḥ kṣamaḥ

stav-p06-v60.plain_english: Homage to turn the real and the fake to nought or to aught — to the bound and the free, who wears wasting and sway as one.
stav-p06-v60.sanskrit_cite: namaḥ sadasatāṃ kartum asattvaṃ sattvam eva vā svatantrāyāsvatantrāya vyayaiśvaryaikaśāline

stav-p07-v61.plain_english: Any joy glimpsed here in all three worlds — a droplet of whom? To that sea-of-bliss god I bend.
stav-p07-v61.sanskrit_cite: trailokye 'py atra yo yāvān ānandaḥ kaścid īkṣyate sa bindur yasya taṃ vande devam ānandasāgaram

stav-p07-v62.plain_english: Ah, lucky Brahmā and the rest — dropped all chatter, drunk with delight they mumble: Śiva, hail, hail.
stav-p07-v62.sanskrit_cite: aho brahmādayo dhanyā ye vimuktānyasaṃkatham namo namaḥ śivāyeti japanty āhlādavihvalāḥ

stav-p07-v63.plain_english: Hail the hungerless apportioner of hunger without end; though the world never began, its feaster — Bhava, take my bow.
stav-p07-v63.sanskrit_cite: niṣkāmāyāpi kāmānām anantānāṃ vidhāyine anāditve 'pi viśvasya bhoktre bhava namo 'stu te

stav-p07-v64.plain_english: The lord we laud, taproot of the triple world's start — who would beg a favour of the flawless?
stav-p07-v64.sanskrit_cite: stumas tribhuvanārambhamūlaprakṛtim īśvaram lipseran nopakāraṃ ke yataḥ sampūrṇadharmaṇaḥ

stav-p07-v65.plain_english: Sunk in dire straits, muddied by floods of folly — let him be recalled, and minds grow lucid: Śiva we sing.
stav-p07-v65.sanskrit_cite: mahatsv apy arthakṛcchreṣu mohaughamalinīkṛtāḥ smṛte yasmin prasīdanti matayas taṃ śivaṃ stumaḥ

stav-p07-v66.plain_english: Lord, from you only, unbroken sway holds here — at whose nod the three worlds fold and unfold.
stav-p07-v66.sanskrit_cite: prabho bhavata eveha prabhuśaktir abhaṅgurā yadicchayā pratāyete trailokyasya layodayau

stav-p07-v67.plain_english: Aim filth at him and it turns sterling; aim merit elsewhere — O, nowhere else such alchemy.
stav-p07-v67.sanskrit_cite: kukarmāpi yam uddiśya devaṃ syāt sukṛtaṃ param sukṛtasyāpi saukṛtyaṃ yato 'nyatra na so 'si bhoḥ

stav-p07-v68.plain_english: 'Caught in our fist, caught in our sight — where will you slip from us?' — so, drunk on love's sap, the lucky sprint for the Matted One.
stav-p07-v68.sanskrit_cite: eṣa muṣṭyā gṛhīto 'si dṛṣṭa eṣa kva yāsi naḥ iti bhaktirasādhmātā dhanyā dhāvanti dhūrjaṭim

stav-p07-v69.plain_english: You we laud — sung in verse, formula, chant, from light, from farther, farthest — your lore-body to be known — ah, sombre and fair.
stav-p07-v69.sanskrit_cite: stumas tvām ṛgyajuḥsāmnāṃ śukrataḥ parataḥ param yasya vedātmikājñeyam aho gambhīrasundarī

stav-p07-v70.plain_english: Law and start and close of the world are you, high Lord — the host of duties marched out: unissued from you, whence could it march?
stav-p07-v70.sanskrit_cite: vidhir ādis tathānto 'si viśvasya parameśvara dharmagrāmaḥ pravṛtto yas tvatto na sa kuto bhavet

stav-p08-v71.plain_english: To you I bow — you conjure the churned stupor of becoming, then shatter it: bliss of gnosis, no pairs — O god, veiler and unveiler.
stav-p08-v71.sanskrit_cite: namas te bhavasambhrāntabhrāntim udbhāvya bhindate jñānānandaṃ ca nirdvandvaṃ deva vṛtvā vivṛṇvate

stav-p08-v72.plain_english: What longings could sound her farthest shore — her who filches glamour in a single blink? Śiva, keep us.
stav-p08-v72.sanskrit_cite: yasyāḥ prāpyeta paryantaviśeṣaḥ kair manorathaiḥ māyām ekanimeṣeṇa muṣṇaṃs tāṃ pātu naḥ śivaḥ

stav-p08-v73.plain_english: Freedom's hard road, wisdom's high crown, hunger's last ridge — their bearer, lord, is you.
stav-p08-v73.sanskrit_cite: vairāgyasya gatiṃ gurvīṃ jñānasya paramāṃ śriyam naiḥspṛhyasya parāṃ koṭiṃ bibhratāṃ tvaṃ prabho prabhuḥ

stav-p08-v74.plain_english: Brahmā himself has Brahmā in you; what master owns no master in you, master of masters? Bliss of the world's bliss — who gauges how huge you are?
stav-p08-v74.sanskrit_cite: brahmaṇo 'pi bhavān brahma kasya neśas tvam īśituḥ jagatkalyāṇakalyāṇaṃ kiyat tvam iti vetti kaḥ

stav-p08-v75.plain_english: Kinsmen avail what, comrades what, patrons what? My lord, in every strait it is you who hauls us off the sea of birth.
stav-p08-v75.sanskrit_cite: kim anyair bandhubhiḥ kiṃ ca suhṛdbhiḥ svāmibhis tathā sarvasthāne mameśa tvaṃ ya uddhartā bhavārṇavāt

stav-p08-v76.plain_english: Hail the heaven-dew beads — hauled by discipline's force, strong to rinse folly, glamour, grime.

stav-p08-v77.plain_english: The chant hymns his thought-kindling blaze — O may he urge our minds down the straight track, our lord.
stav-p08-v77.sanskrit_cite: gāyatryā gīyate yasya dhiyāṃ tejaḥ pracodakam codayed api kaccin naḥ sa dhiyaḥ satpathe prabhuḥ

stav-p08-v78.plain_english: Eight-bodied one — in one body at least, grant us ground that holds; or glad-hearted, grant us everything.
stav-p08-v78.sanskrit_cite: aṣṭamūrte kim ekasyām api mūrtau na naḥ sthitim śāśvatīṃ kuruṣe yad vā tuṣṭaḥ sarvaṃ kariṣyasi

stav-p08-v79.plain_english: Things prove their truth by work they do — but your bare name, lord, perfects through to release.
stav-p08-v79.sanskrit_cite: vastutattvaṃ padārthānāṃ prāyeṇārthakriyākaram bhavatas tv īśa nāmāpi mokṣaparyantasiddhidam

stav-p08-v80.plain_english: Stage after stage you reset the painted world, ever and again — lord, at that craft of yours, what keen heart is not stunned?
stav-p08-v80.sanskrit_cite: muhur muhur jagaccitrasy-ānyānyāṃ sthitim ūhitum śaktir yā te tayā nātha ko manasvī na vismitaḥ

stav-p09-v81.plain_english: Make the hard handy and sweeten the bitter — his memory alone is valiant: him we mind, the lover's bane.
stav-p09-v81.sanskrit_cite: duṣkaraṃ sukarīkartuṃ duḥkhaṃ sukhayituṃ tathā ekavīrā smṛtir yasya taṃ smarāmaḥ smaradviṣam

stav-p09-v82.plain_english: Long live the hymns that sing the high lord — at whose bare name the great break out in bristling thrill.
stav-p09-v82.sanskrit_cite: jayanti gītayo yāsāṃ sa geyaḥ parameśvaraḥ yannāmnāpi mahātmānaḥ kīryante pulakāṅkuraiḥ

stav-p09-v83.plain_english: Were you as you are, O Becoming, in the beyond — your hosts of power marshalled to launch and close the triple world.
stav-p09-v83.sanskrit_cite: bhavān iva bhavān eva bhaved yadi paraṃ bhava svaśaktivyūhasaṃvyūḍhatrailokyārambhasaṃhṛtiḥ

stav-p09-v84.plain_english: Spell you are, spell-fit you are, spell-master — what second wizard besides you? Come, hand me that spell, lord, that I turn spellbound to you.
stav-p09-v84.sanskrit_cite: mantro 'si mantraṇīyo 'si mantrī tvattaḥ kuto 'paraḥ sa mahyaṃ dehi taṃ mantraṃ tvanmantraḥ syāṃ yathā prabho

stav-p09-v85.plain_english: Light-shaped, vow-true — the self in you is mine, am I: yet called a drifter — O lord, what dream is this, and how in you?
stav-p09-v85.sanskrit_cite: bhārūpaḥ satyasaṃkalpas tvam ātmā yasya so 'py aham saṃsārīti kim īśaiṣa svapnaḥ so 'pi kutas tvayi

stav-p09-v86.plain_english: Unsnapped, unchurlish, single, sound — in you, lord, stands the fortune of men who stake their harvest on you.
stav-p09-v86.sanskrit_cite: tad abhaṅgi tad agrāmyaṃ tad ekam upapattimat tvayi karmaphalanyāsakṛtām aiśvaryam īśa yat

stav-p09-v87.plain_english: Strong to crush what ills, to deal what boons — or not? Here he is, our darling, god of gods on the bull-flag.
stav-p09-v87.sanskrit_cite: kṣamaḥ kāṃ nāpadaṃ hantuṃ kāṃ dātuṃ sampadaṃ na vā yo 'sau sa dayito 'smākaṃ devadevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ

stav-p09-v88.plain_english: For god-sight filmed with inborn stain, lord, your love is the last salve that rinses clean.
stav-p09-v88.sanskrit_cite: māyāmayamalāndhasya divyasya jñānacakṣuṣaḥ nirmalīkaraṇe nātha tvadbhaktiḥ paramāñjanam

stav-p09-v89.plain_english: Fear-free, bliss-full, one, unwasting — plant that foothold in me, come, god — quick, why linger?
stav-p09-v89.sanskrit_cite: nirbhayaṃ yad yad ānandamayam ekaṃ yad avyayam padaṃ dehy ehi me deva tūrṇaṃ tat kiṃ pratīkṣase

stav-p09-v90.plain_english: Ah, bottomless and grim, the drowning sea of rounds; ah, to ferry it — some high one — great Master.
stav-p09-v90.sanskrit_cite: aho nisargagambhīro ghoraḥ saṃsārasāgaraḥ aho tattaraṇopāyaḥ paraḥ ko 'pi maheśvaraḥ

stav-p10-v91.plain_english: I bow to you — death's ender, love's crusher, Gaṅgā crowned on the pate, worker of meet right.
stav-p10-v91.sanskrit_cite: namaḥ kṛtakṛtāntānta tubhyaṃ madanamardine mastakanyastagaṅgāya yathāyuktārthakāriṇe

stav-p10-v92.plain_english: High past sway and gnosis, past dispassion and writs stands what men pray for — cut off from you, lord, what loftier haven for the praying?
stav-p10-v92.sanskrit_cite: aiśvaryajñānavairāgyadharmebhyo 'py upari sthitim nātha prārthayamānānāṃ tvad ṛte kā parā gatiḥ

stav-p10-v93.plain_english: Should you not wish it, Śambhu, who could crook a straw? Graced by your wish — who would shirk Brahmā's burden?
stav-p10-v93.sanskrit_cite: tvayy anicchati kaḥ śambho śaktaḥ kubjayituṃ tṛṇam tvadicchānugṛhītas tu vahed brāhmīṃ dhuraṃ na kaḥ

stav-p10-v94.plain_english: The brain-rich, crests high with gemmy wreaths from bending to Hara — to what Highest would they kneel, whom would they not incline?
stav-p10-v94.sanskrit_cite: harapraṇatimāṇikyamukuṭotkaṭamastakāḥ nameyuḥ kaṃ paraṃ kaṃ vā namayeyur na dhīdhanāḥ

stav-p10-v95.plain_english: Quiverless, quit of every stray, a mere of sweet — O let me settle in mid-sea of your knowing, Matted One.
stav-p10-v95.sanskrit_cite: sarvavibhramanirmokaniṣkampam amṛtahradam bhavajjñānāmbudher madhyam adhyāsīyāpi dhūrjaṭe

stav-p10-v96.plain_english: A marvel — eyed askance though it be, strayed into fancy though it be — the last fruit, lord, you grant entire.
stav-p10-v96.sanskrit_cite: citraṃ yac citradṛṣṭo 'pi manorathagato 'pi vā paramārthaphalaṃ nātha paripūrṇaṃ prayacchasi

stav-p10-v97.plain_english: What strong soul outtops you? What stringless soul outpeaks you? So, lord, we sing — bless you? curse you? We cannot say.
stav-p10-v97.sanskrit_cite: ko guṇair adhikas tvattas tvattaḥ ko nirguṇo 'dhikaḥ iti nātha numaḥ kiṃ tvāṃ kiṃ nindāmo na manmahe

stav-p10-v98.plain_english: Though we hymn but the spate of sweet — whose grace fruits in you — to sip it, what stranger is fit? To serve it round — O world-king, who then?
stav-p10-v98.sanskrit_cite: kīrtane 'py amṛtaughasya yatprasatteḥ phalaṃ tava tat pātum api ko 'nyo 'laṃ kim u dātuṃ jagatpate

stav-p10-v99.plain_english: Out of the hoard where every coveted sheaf ripens — from you I beg one thing, lord, in all wise: love of you solely to win.
stav-p10-v99.sanskrit_cite: niḥśeṣaprārthanīyārthasārthasiddhinidhānataḥ tvattas tvadbhaktim evāptuṃ prārthaye nātha sarvathā

stav-p10-v100.plain_english: Hail, triple world's king, hail to you, Becoming — hailed by your court — hail the unbarred might that bestows triple kingship.
stav-p10-v100.sanskrit_cite: namas trailokyanāthāya tubhyaṃ bhava bhavajjuṣām trilokīnāthatādānanirvināyakaśaktaye

stav-p11-v101.plain_english: When men doubt what uproots all ache — master, resolved 'that art thou' — who has failed to flee to you?
stav-p11-v101.sanskrit_cite: niḥśeṣakleśahānasya hetuḥ ka iti saṃśaye svāmin so 'sīti niścitya kas tvāṃ na śaraṇaṃ gataḥ

stav-p11-v102.plain_english: Tasted my fill and shed birth's mirage, I shall win the highest seat — so hope runs here: bright may it blaze for Śambhu's lover.
stav-p11-v102.sanskrit_cite: bhuktvā bhogān bhavabhrāntiṃ hitvā lapsye paraṃ padam ity āśaṃseha śobheta śambhau bhaktimataḥ param

stav-p11-v103.plain_english: Lord, in dreams too, do or utter I foul or fair — proud to hang on you — at home in all places I rest glad.
stav-p11-v103.sanskrit_cite: nātha svapne 'pi yat kuryāṃ brūyāṃ vā sādhv asādhu vā tvadadhīnatvadarpeṇa sarvatrātrāsmi nirvṛtaḥ

stav-p11-v104.plain_english: What lamp of lamps — there, where mind races in your dwelling — mind's lord, could murk touch it? As soon, I deem, as a barren dame's grandson.
stav-p11-v104.sanskrit_cite: jyotiṣām api yaj jyotis tatra tvaddhāmni dhāvataḥ cittasyeśa tamaḥsparśo manye vandhyātmajānujaḥ

stav-p11-v105.plain_english: Methinks one foot already on kind release's road stands he whose hankering runs: 'Śiva I'll honour' — even this.
stav-p11-v105.sanskrit_cite: manye nyastapadaḥ so 'pi kṣemye mokṣasya vartmani manorathaḥ sthito yasya seviṣye śivam ity ayam

stav-p11-v106.plain_english: Through keeping, kindling, killing, in this triple world's errands — yours only, lord, the might — unbound — you watch the weave.
stav-p11-v106.sanskrit_cite: sthityutpattilayair lokatrayasyopakriyāsv iha ekaiveśa bhavacchaktiḥ svatantraṃ tantram īkṣase
