stav-p11-v107.plain_english: Saved in these three worlds, unscorched by triple smart — hail him, hail you — you, the dead-quiet mere of sweet.
stav-p11-v107.sanskrit_cite: trilokyām iha kas trātas tritāpyā nopatāpitaḥ tasmai namo 'stu te yas tvaṃ tannirvāṇāmṛtahradaḥ

stav-p11-v108.plain_english: Feigned love of you still ripens true — were it straight, O what crop? Pronounce it, you.
stav-p11-v108.sanskrit_cite: kṛtrimāpi bhavadbhaktir akṛtrimaphalodayā niśchadmā ced bhaved eṣā kiṃphaleti tvayocyatām

stav-p11-v109.plain_english: The eye that sights you, the road that attains you — that yield, Unborn, springs from the gossip-grove grown of you.
stav-p11-v109.sanskrit_cite: tac cakṣur īkṣyase yena sā gatir gamyase yayā phalaṃ tad aja jātaṃ yat tvatkathākalpapādapāt

stav-p11-v110.plain_english: Best past the good, this poise on high in you — to sweep its hindrances, lord, you are my hold.
stav-p11-v110.sanskrit_cite: śreyasā śreya evaitad upari tvayi yā sthitiḥ tadantarāyahṛtaye tvam īśa śaraṇaṃ mama

stav-p12-v111.plain_english: Ah, honeyed past honey, the savour of serving Śarva hoped — in what tick of time does it not turn ever-new?
stav-p12-v111.sanskrit_cite: aho svādutamaḥ śarvasevāśaṃsāsudhārasaḥ kutra kālakalāmātre na yo navanavāyate

stav-p12-v112.plain_english: Ever, unwearied, teeming the triple world with hundredfold fancies — yet single, seamless, lords it — Unborn.
stav-p12-v112.sanskrit_cite: muhur muhur aviśrāntas trailokyaṃ kalpanāśataiḥ kalpayann api ko 'py eko nirvikalpo jayaty ajaḥ

stav-p12-v113.plain_english: By lore's lamp that licks the birth-greased wick of wonts — god, O when shall I stand in your presence, prithee?
stav-p12-v113.sanskrit_cite: malatailāktasaṃsāravāsanāvartidāhinā jñānadīpena deva tvāṃ kadā nu syām upasthitaḥ

stav-p12-v114.plain_english: Grant one blinking's room with faults outworn to lodge within the breast — then, Śambhu, what feat past your doing?
stav-p12-v114.sanskrit_cite: nimeṣam api yady ekaṃ kṣīṇadoṣe kariṣyasi padaṃ citte tadā śambho kiṃ na sampādayiṣyasi

stav-p12-v115.plain_english: 'Blest am I, quits am I, big am I' — firm would that fancy stand, grounded — his whom you ground, lord.
stav-p12-v115.sanskrit_cite: dhanyo 'smi kṛtakṛtyo 'smi mahān asmīti bhāvanā bhavet sālambanā tasya yas tvadālambanaḥ prabho

stav-p12-v116.plain_english: Luck and muck alike you author yourself — yet love of you mothers luck only, solely, lord.
stav-p12-v116.sanskrit_cite: śubhāśubhasya sarvasya svayaṃ kartā bhavān api bhavadbhaktis tu jananī śubhasyaiveśa kevalam

stav-p12-v117.plain_english: Mind pellucid, master — step you in, or at your stepping does it clear? So dangles man.
stav-p12-v117.sanskrit_cite: prasanne manasi svāmin kiṃ tvaṃ niviśase kim u tvatpraveśāt prasīdet tad iti dolāyate janaḥ

stav-p12-v118.plain_english: Nay, here stands sure — your oversight and yours only: mind's favour, master, is fulfilment, the farthest seat.
stav-p12-v118.sanskrit_cite: niścayaḥ punar eṣo 'tra tvadadhiṣṭhānam eva hi prasādo manasaḥ svāmin sā siddhis tat paraṃ padam

stav-p12-v119.plain_english: Word and wit, work and this frame of mine, lord — grace them to gleam with love of you and nought beside.
stav-p12-v119.sanskrit_cite: vacaś cetaś ca kāryaṃ ca śarīraṃ mama yat prabho tvatprasādena tad bhūyād bhavadbhāvaikabhūṣaṇam

stav-p12-v120.plain_english: This praise-gem, heavy with granted longings, Lakṣmī's lodging of love — for Śambhu wrought Bhaṭṭa Nārāyaṇa.
stav-p12-v120.sanskrit_cite: stavacintāmaṇiṃ bhūrimanorathaphalapradam bhaktilakṣmyālayaṃ śambho bhaṭṭanārāyaṇo vyadhāt

essence: Sweet speech ravishing thought, seer and seen: the conqueror whose greatness is manifest bliss.

sections.SUMMARY: Honeyed lips ravish thought; seen and seer meet; the bliss-manifest great Lord triumphs — high God.

rasa.dominant: adbhuta with bhakti (wonder at manifest greatness)
rasa.justification: Maṅgala opening: speech ravishing, mutual seeing, triumph proclaimed; wonder at greatness resolving into devotion.

essence: Undefeated conqueror grown great with auspicious wealth, knowledge-lit.
Milk-ocean Śaṅkara bowed; hate and praise both address Ambikā's husband who holds the all.
Vast Śambhu of withdrawn touch and full nectar; all-common supreme form undivided in division.
Sthāṇu beyond minute and great; goose-power praised; groundless world-picture bowed.
Milked stainless Śiva-wisdom begged; offering carried to undivided Bhava, ultimate truth's one being.

sections.SUMMARY: The undefeated conquers in auspicious wealth. Śaṅkara the milk-ocean receives homage; hatred and hymn alike reach Ambikā's husband holding all. Vast Śambhu wears withdrawn touch and full nectar; the all-common Lord stays whole in fracture. Sthāṇu spans mote and cosmos; the goose-power spreads wings over the egg; the picture blooms wall-less. Wisdom milked stainless from illusion's waters is begged for; the offering rests with undivided Bhava, one with the ultimate real.

rasa.justification: Each epithet widens the Lord (wealth, ocean, vastness, egg, milk); wonder at scale carried as praise-offering.

essence: Longing to see the deep and dwell in the cave; homage to dream-seers of the bliss-giver.
Desire to contemplate being cuts rebirth-fear; lifelong single-pointed staying resolved.
Veda-bodied wish-tree bowed; entrusting all acts to become you-made and pair-free.
Independent trident power in all cosmic tasks; Dhūrjaṭi's name outdoes meditations.
Mantra refuge praised; every path, word, meditation is the Lord.

sections.SUMMARY: The deep calls to be seen and dwelt in; those who glimpse the moon-crested even asleep earn homage. Hunger to brood on being severs rebirth dread; lifelong one-pointedness is vowed. The Veda-bodied granter bends low; handing over deed, speech, mind, the lover turns you-stuffed and quarrel-free. Alone-working spear-power orders birth and close; one Name outweighs all props. Mantra-sheltered strivers win praise; road, utterance, trance alike end in the Lord.

rasa.dominant: bhakti-śānta with abhilāṣa (longing to see and stay)
rasa.justification: Hunger to see and stay (deep, cave, tree, name) settling into praise; longing fixed one-pointed.

essence: Rasa of worship-meditation-pleasure swells thousandfold in the Lord.
Remembrance alone cures ignorance-darkness; homage itself belongs to Īśa the fulfiller.
Devotion-jewel fished from the dread sea conquers all; few know the veiled knowable.
Qualityless one known of the knowing, desireless fruit of wants, conquers unborn.
Milk-sea fortune natural to the Lord alone; the blossomer gives bliss in being and non-being.
All-knowing, all-doing, all: nothing left but endless offering.

sections.SUMMARY: Tended worship swells thousand-streamed. One recall heals blackout; the bow itself is already his. Fished from terror waters, love's gem buys everything; the open secret stays hid from most. Want-free and trait-free, the Unborn wins and rewards. Sea-churned riches sit easy on him only; he blooms for release, shields in life and lifelessness, and, all-wise, all-working, all, takes all in endless due.

rasa.dominant: bhakti with prasāda (grace received and returned)
rasa.justification: Worship given, grace returned: medicine, jewel, milk, refuge, endless due.

essence: Mere will fruits as three worlds; workings reach past knowing; work-stair climbed by Brahmā.
Power-creeper blooming as gods protects; Mṛḍa errorless, reachless, praised everywhere.
Pride claiming made-of-you yet not in self; rest in mind-bliss after weighing duties.
Subtle yet whole, gross yet unseen; word-nets toiled in vain without you-as-expressible.
Course, rite, wisdom asked: show by teaching, grant grace.

sections.SUMMARY: Bare will bears triple fruit past measure; gods shinny the deed-ladder toward one abode. The power-vine flowers into deities and shields; the stainless one stands unguessed and unreached, hymned in act, memory, vision, touch, arrival. Pride apes union while missing the self; then duty pondered drops into blissful rest. Fineness holds all yet hides from seers; tongues net nothing till you name yourself speakable. So the plea: which road, which rite, which ken reveals you — teach and favour.

rasa.justification: Unknowable reach, unfindable error, unseen grossness, unspoken expressible: wonder circling into plea for teaching.

essence: Needing nothing, helping all three worlds; desired of all, desiring nothing.
Good discernment sows endless-fruited love; great glamour slackens even treasure-holders.
Free doer alone amid all acts; seized worlds need none else's might or mercy.
Fault reaching you turns faultless; greed for you turns worshipful.
Contemplation-deed ennobles worm to Brahmā; beginnings, middles, ends are yours on thought's road.
No savour elsewhere matches love's nectar-liquor.

sections.SUMMARY: The helper wants nothing and feeds all, craved by each, craving none. Clear farmers plant undying affection; the conjuring veil makes even finders drowse. Every start permits, yet only one hand stays free; triple worlds drown till that hand or its kindness hauls out. Vice pointed at you inverts to virtue; clutching at you hallows clutching. One rite of minding you titles grub and godhead alike for freedom; alpha, fray, omega run on mind's lane yours. Beside your love-sap, all relish thins.

rasa.dominant: bhakti with audārya (generosity tasted and returned)
rasa.justification: Help, harvest, hauling, hallowing: gifts moving both ways between Lord and lover, relished as nectar.

essence: Desire withdrawn, longing stretched, moon-crested master bowed; incapable refuge in all-befriending power.
No substitute past strands; nondual self yet cheating glamour; wish-tree sprouts powers, lordship, ending.
Already won, yet when won: tell; clear-heart tenant, ash-white swan bowed.
Twin lamps of waking and love begged; triple play staged and only poet fit to strike.
Real and fake made nought or aught by free-and-bound spender-sovereign.

sections.SUMMARY: Capped hunger bows to the crescent master; empty hands take shelter in all-helping force. Peerless past qualities, the self fools its own through fathomless sheen; still devotion fruits into supernormal bloom, endless sway, birth's close. Won already, the prize stays future — say when; the pellucid-breasted swan keeps house. Two flames are sued, knowing and loving; the worldwright who raised the boards alone can ring them down. Being and non-being trade places at the nod of the boundless bound one.

rasa.justification: Won yet unwon, staged yet unstaged: having bows to becoming; lamps lit against the wait.

essence: Every seen bliss a droplet of the bliss-sea god.
Blessed chanters dropping all talk but Śiva's name.
Want-free apportioner of endless wants, beginningless world's feaster.
Flawless taproot sought by none; remembrance lucidity hymned.
Lone unbroken sway unfolding fall and rise; filth aimed turns sterling.
Fist-caught, sight-caught, never slipped: drunk runners reach the Matted One.
Beyond verse, formula, chant, bright, farther: deep-fair knowable.
Law, start, close of worlds; duties march from none else.

sections.SUMMARY: All delight runs dropwise from one sea. Luckiest throats abandon gossip for the Name mumbled glad-drunk. Hungerless, he deals out hungers and dines though the cosmos never started; faultless root, he wants no hire, yet recall lights skulls that praise. Single sway nods worlds down and up; mud slung his way gilds. Fists and eyes seize him — unseizable — till love-besotted sprinters tackle the Tanglehead. Past metre, mantra, moonstuff, past pastness, his lore-body glows grave and gracious; code, dawn, dusk of the world are him, and duty's columns issue from nowhere else.

rasa.justification: Drop and sea, fist and flight, mud and gilding: contraries held in one vastness, marveled into refuge.

essence: Breaker and uncoverer of churned stupor: gnosis-bliss without pairs.
Māyā-filcher in one blink: protect.
Bearer of freedom's road, wisdom's crown, hunger's ridge: lord.
Brahmā in you; unlorded by none; measure past measure.
Kin, comrades, patrons nothing; you haul from birth-sea everywhere.
Heaven-dew discipline-beads conquer, rinsing folly's stain.
Chant-sung thought-blaze urged straight; eight-bodied asked for lasting ground or all.
Name alone perfects to release; ever-reset painted world amazes the keen.

sections.SUMMARY: Conjure and crack the churned daze: joy-knowledge twinless. Blink-snatch the veil — shield us. Shoulder the triple crown of quit-smoke, clear wit, spent craving: mastery. Even Firstborn finds his First in you; no chief unchiefs you; bliss upon bliss who shall plumb? Blood and bond weigh nil; one Lifter works all harbours. Discipline-drawn dew outcleanses dumps of dark. Gāyatrī's glow goads wits true; eight limbs entreated yield one foothold or the fair. Bare naming outdoes doing; the repainted play stuns each fine mind.

rasa.justification: Haul, shield, rinse, goad, grant, stun: sheltering acts met with daring trust.

essence: Hard made handy, bitter sweetened: sole-valiant memory minds love's bane.
Hymns singing the high one thrill the great at his bare name.
As you, indeed you, in the beyond: power-hosts launch and close triple worlds.
Spell, spell-fit, spell-master: hand the spell making me spellbound.
Light-shaped vow-true self mine, yet drifter-dream — how in you?
Unsnapped, unchurlish, single, sound: fruit-stakers' fortune in you.
Darling able to crush ills and deal boons on the bull-flag.
Love the last salve rinsing filmed god-sight.
Fear-free bliss-one unwasting planted: come quick, why linger?
Bottomless grim rounds-sea; high crosser: great Master.

sections.SUMMARY: One recall steadies the staggering and sugars gall. Anthems to the Tallest raise gooseflesh at syllable one. Be as you be beyond: battalions of force unfurl and furl the threefold. Charm, charm-worthy, charmer — deal the charm that charms me yours. Glow-cast, pledge-fast — myself in you, yet castaway in dream: what sleep lodges in waking? Whole, seemly, sole, sane: your settled fortune funds the trusting. Dearly he smites sorrows and signs fortunes from the horned banner. Last balm of love films clear the filmed god-eye. Dread-free delight, solo, deathless: step in now, tarry never. Fathomless and fearsome the swim; ferry it — Lofty, someone, Master.

rasa.dominant: śṛṅgāra-bhakti with karuṇā (love pleading through dread)
rasa.sthayibhava: rati under fear of the sea
rasa.justification: Gall, dream, sleep, swim, tarry: dread named and crossed by love-sapped pleading.

essence: Death-ender, love-crusher, Gaṅgā-crowned, meet-righter bowed.
Past sway, gnosis, dispassion, writs: no loftier haven cut off from you.
Unwished none crooks straw; wished all shoulder Brahmā's load.
Gem-crested wise bow to no Highest but Hara's.
Quiverless sweet mere mid knowing-sea dwelt in.
Askance-seen, fancy-strayed, last fruit granted whole.
None stronger virtned or stringless: bless or curse unsayable.
None fit to sip nectar-fruit, much less serve it, but you.
One begging from all-desire hoard: love of you solely.
Unbarred triple-kingship might hailed with its court.

sections.SUMMARY: Bunter of Yama, bruiser of Smara, river-crowned, righter. Prayer's perch towers past rule, ken, calm, canon; sundered from you, no shelter stands higher. Unbid, none buckles sedge; bid, all haul heaven's draught. Jewel-pated sages kneel to none Highest save Hara's. Still mere of honey mid mind's main sued for lodgement. Sidelong seen or dream-roamed, ripest meed dealt entire. Brawn or bareness none outranks; hail or hale unspeakable. Nectar yield none else may taste, let alone ladle. From the all-wish barn one alms craved: thee-love lonely. Unchecked triple-throne force cheered amid courtiers.

rasa.justification: Ender, crusher, hauler, dealer, crowner: powers pleaded to share power.

essence: Tat-tvam decided: none fails refuge.
Tasted and shed: highest seat hoped bright for the lover.
Dream doings foul or fair rested glad in dependence-pride.
Murktouch on mind's abode impossible as barren grandson.
Foot on kind release road: serving-Śiva wish stands.
Lone free might watches the triple weave.
Triple-smart unscorched saved: hail extinction-nectar mere.
Feigned love true-fruited: guileless crop pronounced by you.
Seeing-eye, reaching-road fruited from talk's wish-grove.
Better-than-good poise in you: refuge sweeping blocks.

sections.SUMMARY: That-art-thou settled: all flee in, none out. Fed full and mirage-shucked, top lodgement glints for the fond. Night deeds, clean or unclean, nestle glad in leant-on pride. Soot cannot smudge where mind courses his demesne — soon as the childless grandam's grandchild. One sole already on mercy lane hankers 'honour Hara'. Only strength, loose, looms the loom. Scorched by none of the three fires, the saved hail the still-sweet pond. Sham fondness fruits; straight fondness — crop unnamed till thou namest. Eye and highway yield from hearsay's orchard. Peak past prime poised aloft in thee: thou the broom of bars.

rasa.justification: Fleeing in, nesting glad, leaning proud, broomed clear: rest sought and given.

essence: Serving-Śarva savour ever-new each tick.
Untired fancy-teeming one, seamless, lords it unborn.
Lore-lamp licking birth-greased wont-wick: when presence?
Fault-outworn wink-lodging achieves all.
'Blest, quits, big am I' grounded fancy stands by you.
Self-doer of luck and muck; love mothers luck only.
Step in or self-clear? Man dangles; oversight alone decides.
Supervision-only grace is fulfilment, farthest seat.
Word, wit, work, frame gleam with love alone.
wish-jewel of praise heavy with granted longing, love's fortune-house — Nārāyaṇa wrought it for Śambhu

sections.SUMMARY: Wait on Sarva and sweeten hourly new. Unflagging fancy-hatcher stays simplex sovereign sans birth. When burns the wont-wick down to meeting? Blink once clean and command all. Gay vaunts of done-ness stand if thou prop. Thou turnest both wheels; thy love wheels only fair. Dangle between in-step and self-shine till sole survey settles it: mind's smile is siddhi, remotest room. Lip, brain, brawn, bulk gild with thee-love only. Longing-laden wish-jewel, love's fortune-house — teacher Bhatta Narayana built it for the Gracious.

rasa.justification: Ever-new, unwasting, only, remotest: closing gathers all prior hungers into one ornament.

lines: Through honeyed lips that steal the mind, through watcher and the watched,
triumphs the Lord whose power is joy paraded — God on high.
stav-p00-v01.sanskrit_cite: sugirā cittahāriṇyā paśyantyā dṛśyamānayā jayaty ullāsitānandamahimā parameśvaraḥ

lines: Grown great on glory, compassion, awakening, boundless bliss,
knowledge-lit in might — he wins, the Unbeaten.
stav-p01-v02.sanskrit_cite: yaḥ sphītaḥ śrīdayābodhaparamānandasampadā vidyoddyotitamāhātmyaḥ sa jayaty aparājitaḥ
notes: 2026-11-04 owner review: pity -> compassion (dayā = viśvānugrahātmaka parecchāśaktiḥ per Kṣemarāja Vṛtti M00089).
2026-11-04 owner review (trust gradient: Sanskrit first): waking -> awakening (bodha = awakening, V budh; Vrutti jnana glosses function, not word; T1 awakening restored).

lines: To the welling drop and hum, to the self of sheer nectar — hail;
to light unending, to Śaṅkara, the milk-white sea.
You we loathe, you we laud, with you we take counsel — O Ambikā's lord,
how lightly won, how well — the all you shouldered for us.
stav-p01-v04.sanskrit_cite: dviṣmas tvāṃ tvāṃ stumas tubhyaṃ mantrayāmo 'mbikāpate ativāllabhyataḥ sādhu viśvaṅ no dhṛtavān asi

lines: To touch reined in and yoked, to nectar brimming full,
to sky-and-spell-shaped Vast, to Śambhu — hail.
stav-p01-v05.sanskrit_cite: saṃhṛtasparśayogāya sampūrṇāmṛtasūtaye viyanmāyāsvarūpāya vibhave śambhave namaḥ

lines: What splits, unsplit; what severs, whole — we bend
to that all-shared shape of the Highest Lord.
stav-p01-v06.sanskrit_cite: bhinneṣv api na bhinnaṃ yac chinneṣv achinnam eva ca namāmaḥ sarvasāmānyaṃ rūpaṃ tat pārameśvaram

lines: Finer than the sacred-syllable half-mora crown — to mote and mountain both,
wider than the world-egg — hail the traitless-traited, the Pillar.
stav-p01-v07.sanskrit_cite: praṇavordhvārdhamātrāto 'py aṇave mahate punaḥ brahmāṇḍād api nairguṇyaguṇāya sthāṇave namaḥ

lines: Egg-bearer of the cosmos — of the sky-filler, the all-farer,
the High Swan's force — swanlike we sing.
stav-p01-v08.sanskrit_cite: brahmāṇḍagarbhiṇīṃ vyomavyāpinaḥ sarvatogateḥ parameśvarahaṃsasya śaktiṃ haṃsīm iva stumaḥ

lines: Stocked with nothing, backed by no wall, they unfurl the world-canvas —
hail him, craft-famed Spearman.
stav-p01-v09.sanskrit_cite: nirupādānasambhāram abhittāv eva tanvate jagaccitraṃ namas tasmai kalāślāghyāya śūline

lines: Dredged clean from illusion's deep — Self-lore, self-milked: grant,
come, O Hara-Swan, to us.
stav-p01-v10.sanskrit_cite: māyājalodarāt samyag uddhṛtya vimalīkṛtam śivajñānaṃ svato dugdhaṃ dehy ehi harahaṃsa naḥ

lines: Past sixfold proof and parting, to the Partless One,
to the Single State of highest aim — our gift, Bhava, to you.
stav-p01-v11.sanskrit_cite: ṣaṭpramāṇīparicchedabhedayoge 'py abhedine paramārthaikabhāvāya baliṃ yāmo bhavāya te

lines: O let us look on the Profound — ringed with higher light,
dark wiped away, lovely — and harbour in your hollow.
stav-p02-v12.sanskrit_cite: api paśyema gambhīrāṃ pareṇa jyotiṣābhitaḥ unmṛṣṭatamasaṃ ramyām antarbhava bhavadguhām

lines: Hail to them, yea, who dream-caught the crescent-crowned —
the Lord, the giver of unbound delight.
stav-p02-v13.sanskrit_cite: namas tebhyo 'pi ye somakalākalitaśekharam nāthaṃ svapne 'pi paśyanti paramānandadāyinam

lines: Blest One — be! — the ache to brood thy shadowy being,
keen to cut rebirth's scare: whom would it not please?
stav-p02-v14.sanskrit_cite: bhagavan bhava bhāvatkaṃ bhāvaṃ bhāvayituṃ ruciḥ punarbhavabhayocchedadakṣā kasmai na rocate

lines: Life-long, world-Lord, be this our charge — by grace of thee,
to bide with mind one-pointed upon thee alone.
stav-p02-v15.sanskrit_cite: yāvajjīvaṃ jagannātha kartavyam idam astu naḥ tvatprasādāt tvadekāgramanaskatvena yā sthitiḥ

lines: To the body built of thousand-boughed shruti and lore — hail;
to Śambhu, the wishing-tree of endless yield.
Lodging word and thought and body's works in thee, O Master —
grown into thee, twinless: might we be — O ever, O when?
stav-p02-v17.sanskrit_cite: vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmāṇi viniyojya tvayi prabho tvanmayībhūya nirdvandvāḥ kaccit syāmāpi karhicit

lines: For each world's welfare, at each making and unmaking —
to self-powered might, to the Spearman: hail.
Past strand and phase, his mark is the Temple's crown — Dhūrjaṭi's —
his very Name: what prop besides bears fruit for brooders?
stav-p02-v19.sanskrit_cite: vyatītaguṇayogasya mukhyadhyeyasya dhūrjaṭeḥ nāmāpi dhyāyatāṃ dhyānaiḥ kim anyālambanaiḥ phalam

lines: Hail, hail — 'to Śiva' — mantled in chant-force they shelter;
laudable they, bent to quaff Śāmbhavī weal.
stav-p02-v20.sanskrit_cite: namo namaḥ śivāyeti mantrasāmarthyam āśritāḥ ślāghyās te śāmbhavīṃ bhūtim upabhoktuṃ ya udyatāḥ

lines: What road unreached by him? What tongue unspeaking him?
What trance untaking him? What — what is he not, O Lord?
stav-p02-v21.sanskrit_cite: kaḥ panthā yena na prāpyaḥ kā ca vāṅ nocyase yayā kiṃ dhyānaṃ yena na dhyeyaḥ kiṃ vā kiṃ nāsi yat prabho

lines: Honoured here, mused here, gladdened here — this very tang —
in thousand rills, Bhava, in me, of mine — O swell.
stav-p03-v22.sanskrit_cite: arcito 'yam ayaṃ dhyāta eṣa toṣita ity ayam rasaḥ srotaḥsahasreṇa tvayi me bhava vardhatām

lines: Hail the home where wit-lords garland — the Master, the Pillar,
thine, snake-threaded across the breast.
stav-p03-v23.sanskrit_cite: namo niḥśeṣadhīpatrimālālayamayātmane nāthāya sthāṇave tubhyaṃ nāgayajñopavītine

lines: One drug for the gloom of unknowing — thy recall.
Bhava, for its bestowal — favour me with favour.
stav-p03-v24.sanskrit_cite: ajñānatimirasyaikam auṣadhaṃ saṃsmṛtis tava bhava tattatpradānena prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mayi

lines: Hail Īśa, who speeds each human aim to harvest;
bow-worthy — yea, the very bow — whose, here, of the steady?
stav-p03-v25.sanskrit_cite: nama īśāya niḥśeṣapuruṣārthaprasādhakaḥ praṇantavyaḥ praṇāmo 'pi yadīya iha dhīmatām

lines: Sunk in the dread mere where woe-fish school —

lines: Blessed Brahmā's brood, prattle past, who babble glad-drunk,
'Śiva, hail, hail.'

lines: E'en Brahmā finds his Brahmā in thee, whose master

lines: Hail the heaven-dew beads, discipline-drawn and strong,

perfects clean through to freedom.

sole doughty is mind of him: him mind we, Love's bane.

lines: Thrive the lays whose lay is the Lofty One,
at whose mere name the mighty bristle bright.

lines: As thou, e'en thou, shouldst prove beyond, O Becoming,
whose self-ranked onset and offset triple the world.

lines: Charm thou, charm-worthy thou, charmer — what second wizard past thee?

lines: Glow-built, troth-true, thou the soul of whom, ev'n he am I,
'worldling,' say: what, lord, this dream, and how in thee?
stav-p09-v85.sanskrit_cite: bhārūpaḥ satyasaṃkalpas tvam ātmā yasya so 'py aham saṃsārīti kim īśaiṣa svapnaḥ so 'pi kutas tvayi

lines: That seamless, that seemly, that single, reasoned,
in thee, lord, stands yield of yielders-up.
stav-p09-v86.sanskrit_cite: tad abhaṅgi tad agrāmyaṃ tad ekam upapattimat tvayi karmaphalanyāsakṛtām aiśvaryam īśa yat

lines: Meet to smash what sorrow, to deal what treasure, or nay?
yon same is our pet, god over gods, bull-signed.

lines: For god-sight filmed with birth-born stain's eclipse,
in rinse, lord, thy love is sovereign salve.
stav-p09-v88.sanskrit_cite: māyāmayamalāndhasya divyasya jñānacakṣuṣaḥ nirmalīkaraṇe nātha tvadbhaktiḥ paramāñjanam

come, god, fleet: why dally for yon?

lines: Ah, born-deep dread, the drowning round of births,
ah, the ferry-scheme: some Arch, great Master.

lines: O'er sway and ken, past passion, past writ stands prayed-for poise,
sundered from thee, what haven higher for the prayerful?

lines: Shouldst thou not list it, Śambhu — who could crook a straw?
graced by thy list, who would shirk heaven's yoke?
stav-p10-v93.sanskrit_cite: tvayy anicchati kaḥ śambho śaktaḥ kubjayituṃ tṛṇam tvadicchānugṛhītas tu vahed brāhmīṃ dhuraṃ na kaḥ

to what Utmost kneel they, whom unbowed?

may I settle, Matted-Crown.

so, Lord, we hymn: bless, blame thee? We weet not.
